words.chinese: 接著，隨後，緊隨其後
words.engDef: to happen or come immediately after something else
words.example: The meeting will be followed by a networking reception.

words.chinese: 一份副本；一份複本（通常指文件或資料）
words.engDef: one printed or written version of a document
words.example: Could you please send me a copy of the contract for review?

words.chinese: 大量的；許多（用於強調數量或程度）

words.example: The company invested a great deal of money in research and development.

words.chinese: 大量的；許多（用於不可數名詞）

words.example: The company invested a great deal of money in research and development.

words.chinese: 許多；大量（指不確定數量，通常用於表示多個事物）
words.engDef: several; an amount that is not stated exactly
words.example: A number of employees have expressed concerns about the new policy.

words.chinese: 一系列；多種選擇；範圍
words.engDef: a group of different things of the same general type
words.example: The company offers a range of services to meet diverse client needs.

words.chinese: 一系列；多種選擇
words.engDef: a group of things chosen from a larger set
words.example: The catalog offers a selection of high-quality office supplies.

words.chinese: 一系列；一連串（通常指事件、步驟或項目）

words.example: The company is implementing a series of cost-cutting measures to improve profitability.

words.chinese: 一張（紙）；一份（文件）

words.example: Could you please hand me a sheet of paper to take notes?

words.chinese: 一系列；一連串
words.engDef: a number of similar things happening one after another
words.example: The email contained a string of errors that needed to be corrected.

words.chinese: 各式各樣的；多種多樣的（指數量或種類很多）

words.example: The company offers a variety of products to cater to different customer needs.

words.chinese: 簡略版；縮寫版（通常指書籍、文件等內容被縮短後的版本）
words.engDef: a shorter version of a book or document
words.example: The editor provided an abridgment of the lengthy report for the executive summary.

words.chinese: 突然地；驟然地
words.engDef: suddenly and without warning
words.example: The meeting was abruptly canceled due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 引人入勝的；吸引人的；吸收的
words.engDef: so interesting that it holds your full attention
words.example: The training seminar was so absorbing that many participants stayed late to continue learning.

words.chinese: 被接受；同意；批准
words.engDef: agreed to or approved by others
words.example: The proposal was accepted by the board of directors.

words.chinese: 不小心地；意外地（指因疏忽或未經意間發生的事情）
words.engDef: by chance and without intending to
words.example: I accidentally deleted the important file; I'm so sorry.

words.chinese: 完成；達成（目標、任務等）

words.example: The project team managed to accomplish all the objectives within the deadline.

words.chinese: （尤指在某方面）有成就的；技藝精湛的
words.engDef: very skilled at something after long practice
words.example: The company is proud to have an accomplished sales team that consistently exceeds targets.

words.chinese: 根據；依照；根據…的

words.example: The project timeline is according to the client's specifications.

words.chinese: 根據；依照；根據…的說法
words.engDef: as stated or reported by someone or something
words.example: According to the report, sales increased by 15% this quarter.

words.chinese: 精確地；準確地，尤其指在數據、報告或資訊方面
words.engDef: in a way that is exactly correct
words.example: The report needs to be updated to accurately reflect the current market trends.

words.chinese: 習慣於；適應於
words.engDef: used to something because you have done it often
words.example: Our team is accustomed to working long hours during peak season.

words.chinese: 可實現的；可達成的
words.engDef: possible to do or reach
words.example: The company set an achievable sales target for the new quarter.

words.chinese: 獲得的；後天學得的；取得的
words.engDef: gained or obtained rather than born with
words.example: The company has acquired a reputation for excellent customer service.

words.chinese: 在...的對面；位於...的另一側
words.engDef: on the opposite side of a road, room, or space
words.example: The office building is located across from the train station, making it easily accessible for employees.

words.chinese: 活動；事務；業務
words.engDef: things that people do, especially as part of work
words.example: The company organizes team-building activities to improve employee morale.

words.chinese: 行為；作為；行動
words.engDef: things that someone does; actions taken
words.example: The company's actions demonstrated a commitment to environmental sustainability.

words.chinese: 適應性強的；能適應變化的
words.engDef: able to change easily to fit new conditions
words.example: The company needs employees who are adaptable to changing market conditions.

words.chinese: 新增；附加；增加
words.engDef: put together with something else to make it larger
words.example: The marketing team added a new feature to the product to attract more customers.

words.chinese: 增加；附加；增添
words.engDef: putting something with another thing to increase it
words.example: The company is adding new features to its software to improve user experience.

words.chinese: 此外；另外；額外地
words.engDef: as an extra thing; besides what has been said
words.example: The project budget has increased; additionally, the deadline has been extended.

words.chinese: 處理；解決；（信件、包裹等）寄送至；（問題、議題等）探討
words.engDef: dealing with a problem or speaking to a subject directly
words.example: The IT department is addressing the network outage as a top priority.

words.chinese: 增加；附加；添加
words.engDef: puts something together with another thing
words.example: The software update adds several new features to improve user experience.

words.chinese: 擅長；精通；熟練
words.engDef: very good at doing something difficult
words.example: She is adept at using various software programs, making her a valuable asset to the team.

words.chinese: 充份地；適當地；足以
words.engDef: enough for what is needed
words.example: The company ensured that all employees were adequately trained before taking on new responsibilities.

words.chinese: 遵守；堅持；黏附
words.engDef: to follow a rule or stick firmly to a surface
words.example: All employees are required to adhere to the company's code of conduct.

words.chinese: 緊鄰的；相鄰的
words.engDef: next to or very near something
words.example: The conference room is adjacent to the cafeteria, making it convenient for attendees to grab lunch.

words.chinese: 使休會，使延期
words.engDef: to break off a meeting with the intention of resuming it later
words.example: The chairperson decided to adjourn the annual meeting until next Thursday.

words.chinese: 休會，延期
words.engDef: an act of adjourning; a postponement of a meeting
words.example: The adjournment of the negotiation gave both sides time to reconsider.

words.chinese: 調整；適應；修改
words.engDef: to change something slightly so it works better
words.example: Please adjust the font size to 12 points for better readability.

words.chinese: 調整；修改（以符合特定標準或需求）
words.engDef: changed slightly to fit a standard or need
words.example: The project timeline was adjusted to accommodate the unexpected delay.

words.chinese: 調整；修改（以適應新情況或需求）
words.engDef: small changes made to improve or correct something
words.example: The company is making adjustments to its marketing strategy to better reach its target audience.

words.chinese: 承認；允許進入；接納（某事）
words.engDef: agreed that something is true, or allowed to enter
words.example: The company admitted a mistake in the report and issued a public apology.

words.chinese: 建議的；可取的；明智的
words.engDef: sensible and worth doing
words.example: It's advisable to review the contract carefully before signing.

words.chinese: 就...給...建議；就...向...提供意見
words.engDef: to formally tell someone about something
words.example: The consultant advised the company to invest in renewable energy sources.

words.chinese: 顧問；建議人，通常指在特定領域提供專業意見的人。
words.engDef: a person who gives expert help or opinions
words.example: Before making a significant investment, it's wise to consult a financial adviser.

words.chinese: 建議；勸告
words.engDef: gives someone an opinion about what they should do
words.example: The consultant advises the company to invest in renewable energy.

words.chinese: 顧問；建議人（通常指在特定領域提供專業意見的人）
words.engDef: a person whose job is to give expert opinions
words.example: Before making any investment decisions, it's wise to consult a financial advisor.

words.chinese: 受到…影響；受…所及
words.engDef: changed or influenced by something
words.example: The company's profits were significantly affected by the recent economic downturn.

words.chinese: 影響；左右；產生影響
words.engDef: having an influence on something or someone
words.example: The recent economic downturn is significantly affecting the company's sales figures.

words.chinese: 附加；黏貼；（語言學上）前綴或後綴
words.engDef: to stick or attach something to a surface
words.example: The company decided to affix a new logo to all marketing materials.

words.chinese: 其後；事後；之後
words.engDef: at a later time; after that
words.example: Afterward, please submit your expense report to the accounting department.

words.chinese: 代理人；經紀人；代表
words.engDef: people who act or do business for others
words.example: Our travel agents can assist you with booking flights and hotels.

words.chinese: 協議；合約；一致的意見
words.engDef: a decision that two or more sides accept
words.example: Both parties signed the agreement to finalize the deal.

words.chinese: 比原定時間提前；提早完成
words.engDef: earlier than the planned time
words.example: The project was completed ahead of schedule, thanks to the team's efficient work.

words.chinese: （資源、時間、空間等）被分配、指定給；撥遣給
words.engDef: given out for a particular purpose
words.example: The company has allocated a budget of $10,000 for employee training.

words.chinese: 分配
words.engDef: the act of giving out money, time, or resources
words.example: The company's new allocation initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.

words.chinese: 分配；指派（資源、任務等）
words.engDef: to give a share of something to someone
words.example: The manager decided to allot each team member a specific project.

words.chinese: 允許；容許；使...可以
words.engDef: letting something happen or be done
words.example: The company policy allows employees to work remotely up to three days a week.

words.chinese: 允許；容許；使...可以
words.engDef: lets someone do something or makes it possible
words.example: The company's policy allows employees to work remotely two days a week.

words.chinese: 與...同時；連同
words.engDef: together with something or someone else
words.example: Please submit your expense report along with the receipts.

words.chinese: 更改、修改（原樣貌或狀態）
words.engDef: changed from the original form
words.example: The contract has been altered to reflect the latest negotiations.

words.chinese: 作為替代方案；另外地
words.engDef: as another possible choice
words.example: We can ship the product via FedEx or, alternatively, UPS.

words.chinese: 安曼達 (Amanda) 是常見的女性名字，在商務情境中通常指代某位員工或客戶。
words.engDef: a common female first name
words.example: Amanda from the marketing department will be leading the presentation.

words.chinese: 令人驚嘆的；非凡的；極好的（通常指超出預期或令人印象深刻的品質或表現）
words.engDef: extremely good or surprising
words.example: The presentation was truly amazing; the data clearly demonstrated the project's success.

words.chinese: 美國的；美國人的；與美國相關的。
words.engDef: relating to the United States or its people
words.example: The company is expanding its operations to the American market.

words.chinese: 充裕地；充分地；大到足以
words.engDef: more than enough
words.example: The company's resources are amply sufficient to cover the project's expenses.

words.chinese: 分析；仔細研究（某事物）以評估其組成部分或找出其重要特徵。
words.engDef: examined carefully to understand the parts
words.example: The marketing team analyzed the sales data to identify trends.

words.chinese: 分析；評估（數據、資訊等）以做出決策或得出結論。
words.engDef: examining data or facts in detail to understand them
words.example: The marketing team is currently analyzing sales data to identify trends.

words.chinese: 安德魯（男子名）
words.engDef: a common male first name
words.example: Andrew from the sales department will be handling the new account.

words.chinese: 附加於主要文件或建築物的一部份，通常是為了擴展空間或功能。
words.engDef: a building added to a main one, or to add territory
words.example: The company decided to annex a new office space to accommodate the growing team.

words.chinese: 添加註釋的；已做標註的
words.engDef: with notes added to explain the text
words.example: The sales report was heavily annotated with comments and suggestions from the marketing team.

words.chinese: 預期的；預先設想的；預料到的
words.engDef: expected before it happens
words.example: The company announced the product launch, which was highly anticipated by investors.

words.chinese: 不再，從今以後不再（表示否定或變化）
words.engDef: any longer; from now on
words.example: We no longer offer free shipping; it's not included anymore.

words.chinese: 任何地方；隨處
words.engDef: in or to any place
words.example: The manager said we could hold the meeting anywhere convenient for the team.

words.chinese: 服裝；衣著（通常指正式或商業場合的服飾）
words.engDef: clothing, especially when sold in shops
words.example: The company dress code requires all employees to wear professional apparel.

words.chinese: 顯然地；似乎是
words.engDef: according to how something seems
words.example: Apparently, the project deadline has been extended due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 出現；呈現；顯現
words.engDef: came into sight or became noticeable
words.example: The error message appeared on the screen after the system update.

words.chinese: 出現；呈現；顯現
words.engDef: comes into sight or seems to be true
words.example: The error message appears on the screen after the system update.

words.chinese: 附加；增補；添加
words.engDef: to add something to the end of a text
words.example: Please append the revised document to the original email.

words.chinese: 附錄
words.engDef: extra information added at the end of a book or report
words.example: Please refer to Appendix A for a detailed breakdown of the survey results.

words.chinese: 應用；實用；被使用
words.engDef: used for a practical purpose
words.example: The company is looking for candidates with practical experience and applied skills.

words.chinese: 塗抹；適用；申請
words.engDef: puts something on a surface, or is relevant to a case
words.example: The company applies a strict quality control process to all products.

words.chinese: 預約、約會（通常指正式的會議或服務預約）
words.engDef: an arranged time to meet or receive a service
words.example: Please reschedule your appointment with Mr. Smith to next Tuesday.

words.chinese: 預約；約會（通常指商業或專業性質的安排）
words.engDef: arranged times to meet someone or receive a service
words.example: Please reschedule your appointment with Mr. Lee to next Tuesday.

words.chinese: 感到擔憂或不安，對將來的事情感到焦慮。
words.engDef: worried that something bad may happen
words.example: The team was apprehensive about the upcoming merger negotiations.

words.chinese: 批准；核准；同意
words.engDef: officially accepted or agreed to
words.example: The project proposal has been approved by the management team.

words.chinese: 大約；約略；約莫（表示數量、時間等不完全精確的估計）
words.engDef: almost exactly but not completely
words.example: The project is expected to be completed approximately two weeks from today.

words.chinese: 檔案室；檔案資料庫（通常指保存歷史文件、記錄或資料的場所或系統）
words.engDef: a store of historical documents and records
words.example: The company's legal department is responsible for maintaining the archives of all contracts and agreements.

words.chinese: 區域；領域；範圍
words.engDef: parts of a place, or fields of work
words.example: The company is expanding into new geographical areas to increase market share.

words.chinese: （問題、困難等）出現，產生
words.engDef: has happened or come into being, especially a problem
words.example: A technical issue has arisen during the system upgrade, delaying the project timeline.

words.chinese: （問題、困難等）出現；產生；浮現
words.engDef: happens or comes into being, especially a problem
words.example: A conflict of interest arises when an employee's personal gain clashes with the company's best interests.

words.chinese: 即將到來；在不遠的將來（通常指時間或地點），暗示某事即將發生或出現。
words.engDef: going to happen very soon
words.example: The project deadline is just around the corner, so we need to finalize the report immediately.

words.chinese: 安排；整理；協調
words.engDef: to plan and organise the details of something
words.example: Could you arrange a meeting with the marketing team to discuss the new campaign?

words.chinese: 安排約會；預約時間
words.engDef: to plan a time to meet someone
words.example: Could you arrange an appointment with Mr. Lee for next week?

words.chinese: 安排；組織；協調
words.engDef: planned and organised in advance
words.example: The meeting has been arranged for next Tuesday at 2:00 PM.

words.chinese: 安排；協調；計畫
words.engDef: a plan made so that something can happen
words.example: The travel agent made all the necessary arrangements for our business trip.

words.chinese: 安排；籌備；協調
words.engDef: plans and preparations made for an event
words.example: The travel agency is handling all the flight and hotel arrangements for the conference.

words.chinese: 文章；報導；(新聞) 刊物
words.engDef: pieces of writing published in a newspaper or magazine
words.example: The company newsletter features articles on new product launches and employee achievements.

words.chinese: 由於...的結果；因此
words.engDef: because of something that happened
words.example: Due to the unexpected system failure, the project deadline has been extended.

words.chinese: 截至目前；就目前而言
words.engDef: starting from this moment
words.example: As of now, the project is on schedule and within budget.

words.chinese: 與...相反；與...不同
words.engDef: rather than; in contrast to
words.example: Our company prefers direct sales, as opposed to relying on distributors.

words.chinese: 盡快；儘可能早
words.engDef: at the earliest time that can be managed
words.example: Please submit your expense report as soon as possible.

words.chinese: 以及，同時（表示並列關係，且通常與較重要的事物並列）
words.engDef: in addition to something else
words.example: The project manager, as well as his team, will attend the conference.

words.chinese: 盡快；儘早 (通常指立即或在最短時間內)
words.engDef: as quickly as it can be done
words.example: Please send me the report ASAP.

words.chinese: 面向；層面；方面（尤指在分析或討論時考量到的部分）
words.engDef: particular parts or features of a situation
words.example: The project manager needs to consider all aspects of the new marketing campaign.

words.chinese: 指派；分配（任務、職責等）
words.engDef: to give someone a job or duty
words.example: The manager will assign each team member a specific task for the project.

words.chinese: 指派；分配（任務、職責等）
words.engDef: given to someone as a job or duty
words.example: Each team member was assigned a specific task for the project.

words.chinese: 作業；任務；指派的工作
words.engDef: a piece of work given to someone
words.example: The manager assigned each team member a specific assignment to ensure project completion.

words.chinese: 協助；幫助（尤指提供支持或服務）
words.engDef: helping someone with their work
words.example: The junior staff are assisting the senior managers with the project.

words.chinese: 關聯；相關聯；從屬的
words.engDef: connected with something or someone
words.example: The project is associated with a significant increase in operational costs.

words.chinese: 假定；認為（某事為真），預想
words.engDef: believed to be true without proof
words.example: The report assumes a 5% annual growth rate for the next five years.

words.chinese: 假設；認為（某事是真實的）
words.engDef: accepting that something is true before it is proved
words.example: Assuming the project stays on schedule, we should be ready to launch by the end of the quarter.

words.chinese: 敏銳的；洞察力的；精明的（指能迅速且準確地理解事物或情況）
words.engDef: quick to see and use a situation to advantage
words.example: The astute negotiator quickly identified the company's key priorities.

words.chinese: 連續不斷地；一次完成
words.engDef: continuously and without stopping
words.example: I can work on this report for an hour at a stretch, but I'm not sure about longer than that.

words.chinese: 一次一份；逐一
words.engDef: separately, in that number on each occasion
words.example: We need to process these invoices at a time to ensure accuracy.

words.chinese: 隨時；全天候；不論何時
words.engDef: always; on every occasion
words.example: Security personnel must be vigilant at all times.

words.chinese: 立即地；同時地；立刻地
words.engDef: immediately, or all together at the same moment
words.example: Please submit your expense report at once.

words.chinese: 供…使用；隨時可使用
words.engDef: free for someone to use whenever they want
words.example: The conference room and all necessary equipment are at your disposal.

words.chinese: 盡早；在...時間之前（強調盡可能提早）
words.engDef: not before that time
words.example: Please submit your expense report at the earliest possible date.

words.chinese: 在最後一刻；在截止期限前夕
words.engDef: at the latest possible moment before a deadline
words.example: The marketing team submitted the proposal at the last minute due to unforeseen delays.

words.chinese: 最遲於；不遲於
words.engDef: no later than that time
words.example: The report must be submitted at the latest by Friday.

words.chinese: 目前，當下（指特定時間點）
words.engDef: right now
words.example: I'm quite busy at the moment, but I'm happy to discuss this later.

words.chinese: 同時；在同一時間
words.engDef: during the same period as something else
words.example: The project manager needs to coordinate the team's efforts and ensure everyone is working at the same time.

words.chinese: 目前；現階段；到這個時候
words.engDef: at this stage of a process
words.example: At this point, we need to reassess our marketing strategy.

words.chinese: 附加；連接；將...附加到...
words.engDef: to fasten or join one thing to another
words.example: Please attach your resume and cover letter to the email.

words.chinese: 附加的；隨附的；與...連接的
words.engDef: joined or fastened to something else
words.example: Please find the contract attached to this email.

words.chinese: 附加；連接；附著（文件、資料等）
words.engDef: joining one thing to another, such as a file to an email
words.example: Please find the updated report attached to this email.

words.chinese: 附件；附加檔案
words.engDef: a file sent together with an email
words.example: Please find the contract details as an attachment to this email.

words.chinese: 附件；隨附文件
words.engDef: files or parts joined to a main document or machine
words.example: Please find the presentation slides and budget proposal as attachments to this email.

words.chinese: 可實現的；力所能及的；可達成的
words.engDef: possible to achieve with the resources you have
words.example: The company set an attainable sales target for the new quarter.

words.chinese: 嘗試做某事，但未成功；試圖
words.engDef: tried to do something without succeeding
words.example: The company attempted to negotiate a lower price with the supplier, but without success.

words.chinese: 嘗試做某事，通常是困難或具有挑戰性的。
words.engDef: trying to do something difficult
words.example: The company is attempting to expand its market share in Asia.

words.chinese: 嘗試；努力（指進行某事），通常指多次嘗試
words.engDef: efforts made to do something
words.example: Despite several attempts to resolve the technical issue, the system remained offline.

words.chinese: 出席；參加（會議、活動等）
words.engDef: being present at an event or meeting
words.example: All employees are required to attend the mandatory training session.

words.chinese: 出席；參加（會議、活動等）
words.engDef: is present at a meeting or event
words.example: All employees are required to attend the mandatory training session.

words.chinese: 服裝；穿著（通常指正式或典雅的服飾）
words.engDef: clothes, especially formal ones for an occasion
words.example: The company dress code requires business attire for all client meetings.

words.chinese: 注意；請注意（縮寫，來自 Attention）
words.engDef: for the attention of a named person
words.example: Attn: Marketing Department - Please review the attached proposal.

words.chinese: 歸因於；將…歸功於
words.engDef: said to be caused by or made by someone
words.example: The company attributed its success to its dedicated employees and innovative strategies.

words.chinese: 特徵、屬性（通常指某物或某人的獨特品質或特徵，在商務情境中常用於描述產品、服務或員工的優點）
words.engDef: qualities or features that someone or something has
words.example: The software's key attributes include its user-friendly interface and robust security features.

words.chinese: 八月；（古時）受人尊敬的；莊嚴的
words.engDef: the eighth month of the year
words.example: The company's annual conference is scheduled for the first week of August.

words.chinese: 授權
words.engDef: official permission to do something
words.example: The company's new authorization initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.

words.chinese: 可利用性；供應情況；空閒時間
words.engDef: the fact of being free or able to be obtained
words.example: Please check the manager's availability before scheduling a meeting.

words.chinese: 避免；迴避（責任、義務、問題等）
words.engDef: staying away from something or not doing it
words.example: The company is avoiding direct confrontation with the union by offering a compromise.

words.chinese: 對某事或某情況的認識或了解；意識。
words.engDef: knowledge that a situation or fact exists
words.example: Increased employee awareness of safety protocols is crucial for preventing workplace accidents.

words.chinese: 基於；以…為基礎；根據
words.engDef: having its main place or foundation somewhere
words.example: The decision was based on market research and customer feedback.

words.chinese: 基本上；主要地；簡單來說
words.engDef: in the most important respects; put simply
words.example: Basically, the project is on track, but we need to finalize the budget.

words.chinese: 洗手間、衛生間（通常指多間或公共場所的洗手間）
words.engDef: rooms with a toilet and washing facilities
words.example: The building's bathrooms are being renovated to improve accessibility.

words.chinese: 缺席；不在（某地）
words.engDef: to not be present at a place or event
words.example: He was absent from the meeting due to a family emergency.

words.chinese: 被告知；被通知（某事），通常是正式或重要的資訊。
words.engDef: to be officially told about something
words.example: You will be advised of any changes to the meeting schedule.

words.chinese: 隸屬；與…相關聯；與…有關係
words.engDef: to be officially connected to an organisation
words.example: Our company is affiliated with a leading research institution.

words.chinese: 被允許做某事；獲得許可做某事
words.engDef: to have permission to do something
words.example: Employees are allowed to use the company's Wi-Fi for personal use during breaks.

words.chinese: 非常渴望做某事；熱切期盼做某事
words.engDef: to want very much to do something
words.example: The marketing team is anxious to launch the new product line before the holiday season.

words.chinese: 被要求做某事；被指示做某事
words.engDef: to be requested to do something
words.example: Employees are asked to submit their expense reports by the end of the month.

words.chinese: 被指派到；被分配到（某任務、部門或職位）
words.engDef: to be given a particular job, place, or department
words.example: New employees are often assigned to the sales department for initial training.

words.chinese: 留意、知悉、注意（某事），尤其是在商務情境中指對潛在風險、問題或機會的認識。
words.engDef: to know that something exists or is happening
words.example: Employees should be aware of the company's new policy regarding remote work.

words.chinese: 基於；以…為基礎
words.engDef: to use something as the foundation for something else
words.example: The company's pricing strategy is based on market research and competitor analysis.

words.chinese: 決心去做；下定決心去做
words.engDef: to have firmly decided to do something
words.example: The company is determined to increase its market share by 10% this year.

words.chinese: 熟悉、了解（某事物或程序），通常指經過經驗或學習而獲得的知識或技能。
words.engDef: to know something well from experience
words.example: New employees are expected to be familiar with the company's policies and procedures.

words.chinese: 充滿；充斥著（某事物），通常指數量或程度非常多。
words.engDef: to contain a large amount of something
words.example: The conference room was full of attendees eager to hear the keynote speaker.

words.english: be in a position to do
words.chinese: 有能力、有機會做某事；處於能夠做某事的狀況
words.engDef: to be able to do something because circumstances allow it
words.example: After completing the training, she will be in a position to handle the project independently.

words.chinese: 受到…影響；受…左右
words.engDef: to be affected or changed by something
words.example: The company's marketing strategy is heavily influenced by current market trends.

words.chinese: 與...無關；不適用於...
words.engDef: to have no connection with a matter
words.example: The new regulations are irrelevant to our current project.

words.chinese: 很有可能；預計會...
words.engDef: to be expected to happen or be true
words.example: The project is likely to be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 對...特別感興趣（指某事物或資訊對某人或群體具有特別的吸引力或重要性）
words.engDef: to be especially important or appealing to someone
words.example: The new marketing strategy is of particular interest to our sales team.

words.chinese: 屬於；被...擁有
words.engDef: to belong to a person or company
words.example: The company is owned by a private equity firm.

words.chinese: 與…相關；與…有關
words.engDef: to be connected with something
words.example: This project is related to the company's long-term strategic goals.

words.chinese: 不願意做某事；猶豫於做某事
words.engDef: to be unwilling to do something
words.example: The marketing team is reluctant to invest in a new advertising campaign due to budget constraints.

words.chinese: 對...感到滿意，接受...
words.engDef: to be pleased with what you have received
words.example: The project manager was satisfied with the team's progress and decided to move forward.

words.chinese: 被安排進行（某事）；預定進行（某事）
words.engDef: to be planned to happen at a stated time
words.example: The meeting with the potential investor is scheduled for next Tuesday.

words.chinese: 與...相似，與...雷同
words.engDef: to be almost the same as something else
words.example: The new software's interface is very similar to the previous version.

words.chinese: 分散開來；攤開；擴散開來（通常指資訊、資源或人員）
words.engDef: to cover a wide area rather than one place
words.example: The company decided to spread out its marketing budget across multiple platforms to reach a wider audience.

words.chinese: 應該做、預期要做（表示義務、責任或計畫）
words.engDef: to be expected or required to do something
words.example: You are supposed to submit your expense report by the end of the week.

words.chinese: 厭倦；對...感到疲憊或不耐煩（通常指某事物或情況）
words.engDef: to have had enough of something and want it to stop
words.example: I'm tired of working overtime every weekend.

words.chinese: 不願意做某事；缺乏意願
words.engDef: to not want to do something
words.example: The marketing team is unwilling to allocate more budget for the campaign.

words.chinese: 熬夜，晚睡，長時間工作或活動到深夜
words.engDef: to stay awake until late at night
words.example: I had to be up late last night finishing the quarterly report.

words.chinese: 習慣於（做某事）；經常用於（做某事）
words.engDef: to be familiar with doing something because it is usual
words.example: Our team is used to working long hours during peak season to meet customer demand.

words.chinese: 成為，變成
words.engDef: changed into or started to be something
words.example: The company became a leader in the renewable energy sector after years of research and development.

words.chinese: 變成；成為
words.engDef: changes into or starts to be something
words.example: The company's new policy becomes effective on January 1st.

words.chinese: 逐漸成為；正在發展成為
words.engDef: gradually changing into something
words.example: The company is becoming a leader in the renewable energy sector.

words.chinese: 開始；起始
words.engDef: started
words.example: The project began on schedule, despite initial setbacks.

words.chinese: 開始；開端；起始
words.engDef: the first part or the start of something
words.example: The project is at the beginning stages of development.

words.chinese: 開始；起始
words.engDef: starts
words.example: The meeting begins promptly at 10:00 AM.

words.chinese: 開始；起始 (指某事已經開始進行)
words.engDef: started, and now under way
words.example: The project has begun, and we need to allocate resources accordingly.

words.chinese: 行為；舉止；表現
words.engDef: the way a person or thing acts
words.example: The manager addressed the employee's inappropriate behavior during the meeting.

words.chinese: 比原定計畫落後；延遲
words.engDef: later than the planned time
words.example: We are currently behind schedule due to unforeseen technical issues.

words.chinese: 姍姍來遲地；晚了才...
words.engDef: later than it should have been done
words.example: The report was submitted belatedly due to unforeseen technical issues.

words.chinese: 相信；認為（某事是真的）
words.engDef: accepted as true
words.example: The company believed that investing in employee training would increase productivity.

words.chinese: 屬於；歸屬於
words.engDef: to be the property of, or be a member of
words.example: This document belongs to the Marketing Department and should not be shared with others.

words.chinese: 皮帶；（通常指）腰帶
words.engDef: strips of leather or cloth worn around the waist
words.example: The company policy requires all employees to wear a belt with their uniforms.

words.chinese: 彎腰；俯身
words.engDef: to lean forward and down from the waist
words.example: Please bend over and pick up the dropped documents.

words.chinese: 建議採取某種做法，通常表示比其他做法更有效或合適。
words.engDef: it is a wiser choice to do something
words.example: It would be better to schedule a meeting next week to discuss the budget.

words.chinese: 每兩年一次的；雙年制的
words.engDef: happening once every two years
words.example: The company holds a biannual sales conference to review performance and set goals.

words.chinese: 熱愛書籍、喜歡閱讀的人，通常指藏書量大且熱衷於收集書籍的人。
words.engDef: people who love and collect books
words.example: The company's library caters specifically to the needs of its many bibliophiles.

words.chinese: 雙語的；能夠使用兩種語言流暢溝通的
words.engDef: able to speak two languages well
words.example: Our company seeks bilingual employees to handle international clients.

words.chinese: 每兩週一次（發生的頻率）
words.engDef: happening once every two weeks
words.example: The newsletter is distributed biweekly to keep employees updated on company news.

words.chinese: 白色；空白（指文件、表格等未填寫的狀態）
words.engDef: blank; with nothing written in it
words.example: Please use a blanco form for your expense report.

words.chinese: 瑕疵；污點（指表面上的小缺陷，例如產品上的劃痕或文件上的錯誤）
words.engDef: a small mark or fault that spoils the surface of something
words.example: The quality control team found a small blemish on the product's surface.

words.chinese: 董事會室；公司決策會議室
words.engDef: a room where a company's directors hold meetings
words.example: The presentation will be held in the boardroom at 2:00 PM.

words.chinese: 書架；書櫃
words.engDef: a shelf on which books are kept
words.example: The office manager asked the IT department to install additional bookshelves to accommodate the growing collection of training manuals.

words.chinese: 分支機構；分公司（通常指公司在其他地點設立的辦公室，以擴展業務或提供本地化服務）
words.engDef: a local office of a larger company
words.example: Our company has several branch offices throughout Asia to better serve our clients.

words.chinese: 部門；分支機構；樹枝
words.engDef: local offices of a company, or parts of a tree
words.example: Each branch of the company focuses on a specific product line.

words.chinese: 打破；中斷；損壞；（新聞、紀錄等）報導、揭露
words.engDef: stopping something or damaging it; also news reported as it happens
words.example: The company is breaking ground on a new manufacturing facility next month.

words.chinese: 引入、帶來（通常指帶入某物或某人），或將某事物引入到某個地方。
words.engDef: to introduce something new or invite someone to take part
words.example: Please bring in the latest sales report for our review.

words.chinese: 引發；造成；促成（某種情況或問題）
words.engDef: to cause something, usually unpleasant, to happen
words.example: The excessive workload is bringing on stress and burnout among the team members.

words.chinese: 帶來；攜帶；引入
words.engDef: carrying or taking something to a place or person
words.example: Please remember to bring your presentation materials to the meeting.

words.chinese: 帶來；引入；呈現
words.engDef: carries or takes something to a place or person
words.example: The new software brings significant improvements in efficiency.

words.chinese: 快速且有活力的；（步調）輕快、節奏明快
words.engDef: quick and full of energy
words.example: The manager requested a brisk walk to clear his head before the important meeting.

words.chinese: 帶來；攜帶；引入
words.engDef: carried or took something to a place or person
words.example: The manager brought several important documents to the meeting.

words.chinese: 建築物；大樓（通常指商業或辦公用途的建築物）
words.engDef: structures with walls and a roof, such as offices
words.example: The company is planning to relocate its headquarters to a modern office building downtown.

words.chinese: 公告欄；佈告欄，通常用於張貼公司內部通知、海報或重要資訊。
words.engDef: a board on a wall where notices are put up
words.example: The HR department posted the new company policy on the bulletin board.

words.chinese: 繁重的；負擔的；令人費時的
words.engDef: causing a lot of difficulty or extra work
words.example: The new regulations are quite burdensome for small businesses.

words.chinese: 鎮民；居民（通常指中世紀城市中的居民）
words.engDef: a citizen of a town, especially in earlier times
words.example: The company is committed to providing excellent services to all burgesses in the community.

words.chinese: 商務服裝；正式工作服裝，通常指在職場上穿著的專業服飾。
words.engDef: the formal clothes worn in a professional workplace
words.example: The company dress code requires all employees to wear business attire for client meetings.

words.chinese: 名片；用以交換聯絡資訊的卡片
words.engDef: a small card printed with your name and work contact details
words.example: Please exchange business cards after the meeting to facilitate future communication.

words.chinese: 商業聯絡人；業務關係人，指在商業領域中建立和維護的個人或組織。
words.engDef: people you know through work who may be useful
words.example: The sales team is actively expanding their business contacts to increase market share.

words.chinese: 工作天，不包含週末和法定假日。通常指星期一至星期五。
words.engDef: a normal working day, not a weekend or public holiday
words.example: Please allow 3-5 business days for processing your order.

words.chinese: 營業時間，公司或商店的開放時間
words.engDef: the times of day when a company is open
words.example: Please note that our business hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

words.chinese: 商務談話；關於業務的討論
words.engDef: a discussion about work matters
words.example: Let's schedule a business talk to discuss the new marketing strategy.

words.chinese: 商務人士；從事商業活動的人
words.engDef: people who work in commerce or run companies
words.example: The conference attracted a large number of businesspeople from around the globe.

words.chinese: 整理儀容，穿好襯衫或西裝的鈕扣，使儀容整潔。
words.engDef: to fasten the buttons on a shirt or jacket
words.example: He quickly buttoned up his shirt before the important meeting.

words.chinese: 按鈕；鈕扣（通常指電子設備上的按鈕或服裝上的鈕扣）
words.engDef: small round parts you press, or fasteners on clothes
words.example: The employee needs to reset the system by pressing the reset button.

words.chinese: 相反地；與之相反；相比之下
words.engDef: when compared with something that is very different
words.example: While the initial investment was substantial, the long-term returns have been even greater.

words.chinese: 手工地；以人工方式
words.engDef: done by a person rather than by a machine
words.example: Due to the high volume of orders, some items are still assembled by hand.

words.chinese: 不小心地；錯誤地（指因疏忽或意外），通常指非故意的錯誤。
words.engDef: accidentally, without meaning to
words.example: I accidentally sent the report to the wrong department; I did it by mistake.

words.chinese: 獨自地；靠自己的
words.engDef: alone and without help
words.example: The employee completed the project by oneself, demonstrating excellent initiative.

words.english: by the end of the year
words.chinese: 在年底前；截至今年底
words.engDef: before the year finishes
words.example: The project is expected to be completed by the end of the year.

words.chinese: 在...之前；到...時（表示某件事情在另一件事情發生之前完成或發生）
words.engDef: when a particular moment or event arrives
words.example: By the time the report is finalized, all data should be verified.

words.chinese: 到目前為止；截至目前
words.engDef: by the moment being talked about
words.example: By this time next year, we expect to have completed the project.

words.chinese: 因病缺勤；請病假
words.engDef: to phone work to say you are too ill to come
words.example: I'm feeling unwell today, so I'm going to call in sick.

words.chinese: 取消（計畫、活動等），通常是因為不可抗力或特殊情況。
words.engDef: to cancel something that was planned
words.example: Due to the severe weather conditions, the company has decided to call off the outdoor training session.

words.chinese: 被取消；廢除（計畫、會議等）
words.engDef: stopped or ended before it took place
words.example: The meeting has been canceled due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 取消（預訂、會議等），廢除
words.engDef: deciding that a planned event will not happen
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we are canceling the scheduled meeting.

words.chinese: 無法；不能（表示某事物不具備能力或許可進行某動作）
words.engDef: is not able or not allowed to do something
words.example: I cannot approve this expense report without proper documentation.

words.chinese: 名詞，表示「大寫，資本化，股本總額」。在寫作中指將單字的首字母大寫的規則或行為；在金融領域則指公司發行股票的總市值或將成本轉化為資產的過程。
words.engDef: writing a letter as a capital, or a company's total share value
words.example: Please ensure correct capitalization of all proper nouns in the document.

words.chinese: 卡片；名片；（撲克牌）牌
words.engDef: small pieces of stiff paper used for messages or information
words.example: Please exchange business cards after the meeting.

words.chinese: 小心翼翼地；仔細地；謹慎地（強調細節和避免錯誤）
words.engDef: with close attention, so that mistakes are avoided
words.example: Please review the contract carefully before signing it.

words.chinese: 粗心大意地；不小心地（通常指工作或任務），可能導致錯誤或疏漏。
words.engDef: without enough attention, so mistakes are made
words.example: The report was submitted carelessly, and contained several factual errors.

words.chinese: 捕捉；接住；攔截
words.engDef: takes hold of something moving, or notices a problem
words.example: The security system catches any unauthorized access attempts.

words.chinese: 類別；分類
words.engDef: groups of things that share the same qualities
words.example: The marketing team needs to analyze sales data by product categories.

words.chinese: 將…分類；歸類
words.engDef: to put things into groups by type
words.example: The marketing team needs to categorize all incoming leads based on their potential value.

words.chinese: 貓科動物的複數形式，通常指多隻貓。
words.engDef: small furry animals often kept as pets
words.example: The office pet policy prohibits employees from bringing cats or other animals to work.

words.chinese: 貓咪（複數）；貓科動物（複數），通常指多隻貓。
words.engDef: a family name, also used as a proper name
words.example: The office policy prohibits keeping cats or other pets in the workplace.

words.chinese: 原因；起因；導因
words.engDef: the reasons why something happens
words.example: The company is investigating the causes of the production delay.

words.chinese: 小心翼翼地；謹慎地，以避免風險或意外
words.engDef: carefully, so as to avoid risk or danger
words.example: The project manager approached the negotiation cautiously, considering the client's past behavior.

words.chinese: 中心點；重點；中心區域
words.engDef: middle points, or places where an activity is based
words.example: The training centers provide employees with the skills they need to succeed.

words.chinese: 總辦公室；總部
words.engDef: the main office that controls the other branches
words.example: All departmental heads must submit their quarterly reports to the central office by Friday.

words.chinese: 椅子；座椅
words.engDef: seats with a back for one person
words.example: The conference room has enough chairs for all attendees.

words.chinese: 質疑；挑戰；使面對困難
words.engDef: questioned whether something is right, or given a difficult task
words.example: The new regulations challenge existing business practices.

words.chinese: 具有挑戰性，困難的；需要付出努力的
words.engDef: difficult in a way that tests your ability
words.example: The project presented a challenging deadline, requiring the team to work overtime.

words.chinese: 機會；可能性（通常指某事發生的可能性）
words.engDef: the possibilities that something will happen
words.example: The company has a good chance of securing the contract if they submit a competitive proposal.

words.chinese: 改變；變更；轉變
words.engDef: made or became different
words.example: The company has changed its policy regarding remote work.

words.chinese: 變動；改變；調整
words.engDef: things that become different, or the act of making them different
words.example: The company is implementing several changes to its operational procedures.

words.chinese: 正在改變、變動的；隨著時間推移而改變的。
words.engDef: becoming different over time
words.example: The company is undergoing significant changes to adapt to the evolving market.

words.chinese: 章節；分段（指書本、報告等的分段）
words.engDef: the numbered parts that a book is divided into
words.example: The report is divided into three chapters, each focusing on a different aspect of the project.

words.example: The maintenance team checks the equipment every other day to ensure optimal performance.

words.chinese: 日常的；每天發生的；普通的
words.engDef: ordinary and happening as part of normal life
words.example: The manager asked the team to prioritize these tasks for their everyday workflow.

words.chinese: 每個人；所有人（指不分個人，包含所有成員）
words.engDef: every person
words.example: Everyone is expected to attend the mandatory training session.

words.chinese: 無處不在；各處
words.engDef: in or to all places
words.example: The company's logo is displayed everywhere in the office building.

words.chinese: 確切地；完全地；精確地
words.engDef: in a way that is completely correct or precise
words.example: Could you please specify exactly what you need for the project?

words.chinese: 仔細檢查；審查；檢驗
words.engDef: looked at something carefully to find out about it
words.example: The auditor examined the company's financial records for any discrepancies.

words.chinese: 範例；例子；示範
words.engDef: things mentioned to show what a group is like
words.example: Could you provide some examples of successful marketing campaigns?

words.chinese: 超過；勝過；超出（數量、標準等）
words.engDef: is greater than a limit or expectation
words.example: The company's sales figures for this quarter exceed last year's by 15%.

words.chinese: 極其出色地；卓越地（表示程度非常高，通常用於形容動作或結果）
words.engDef: extremely well
words.example: The project team completed the presentation excellently, exceeding all expectations.

words.chinese: 除了...以外；除...之外
words.engDef: apart from; not including
words.example: All employees are eligible for the bonus, except for those who were absent for more than five days last month.

words.chinese: 例外；異例；豁免
words.engDef: a case that does not follow the usual rule
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we're making an exception to our usual payment policy.

words.chinese: 交換；互通；交易
words.engDef: acts of giving one thing and receiving another
words.example: The company is looking for a reliable logistics partner to handle product exchanges.

words.chinese: 交換；互通；調換
words.engDef: giving something and receiving something else in return
words.example: The company is exchanging information with its partners to streamline the supply chain.

words.chinese: 不包含；排除
words.engDef: not counting; leaving out
words.example: The price includes shipping, excluding taxes.

words.chinese: 卓越的；示範性的；極好的（用來形容行為、工作或產品等，表示達到或超過了標準）
words.engDef: so good that it can serve as a model for others
words.example: The employee's exemplary performance earned him a promotion.

words.chinese: 體現；以...為例；彰顯
words.engDef: to be a typical example of something
words.example: This project exemplifies the company's commitment to innovation and quality.

words.chinese: 極度疲憊；筋疲力盡，通常指因長時間工作或活動而產生的身心俱疲。
words.engDef: extremely tired, with no energy left
words.example: After the long presentation, the speaker looked completely exhausted.

words.chinese: 現存的；已存在的；現有的
words.engDef: present or in use now
words.example: The company is reviewing its existing policies to ensure compliance with the new regulations.

words.chinese: 經驗；經歷
words.engDef: short for experience
words.example: The candidate's extensive experience in project management made him a strong contender for the position.

words.chinese: 擴展；擴大；增強
words.engDef: made larger or more detailed
words.example: The company's product line has been significantly expanded to meet growing customer demand.

words.chinese: 期望；預期（尤指基於經驗或證據的合理預測）
words.engDef: the state of expecting something to happen
words.example: The company's high expectancy of increased sales this quarter is driving the marketing team to work harder.

words.chinese: 期望；預期，尤其指基於經驗或理性的預測。
words.engDef: a belief that something will happen or should happen
words.example: The company needs to manage client expectations regarding the project timeline.

words.chinese: 預期的；被期望的；預料到的
words.engDef: thought likely to happen or arrive
words.example: The project is expected to be completed by the end of next month.

words.chinese: 預期、期望（某事將會發生或出現）
words.engDef: thinking that something will happen or arrive
words.example: We are expecting a significant increase in sales this quarter.

words.chinese: 經歷；經驗；過往經歷
words.engDef: the things that have happened to you
words.example: The candidate's extensive experiences in project management made him a strong contender for the position.

words.chinese: 正在經歷；體驗到
words.engDef: having something happen to you
words.example: The company is currently experiencing a period of rapid growth.

words.chinese: 專家；專業人士
words.engDef: people with special skill or knowledge in a subject
words.example: Our team consulted with industry experts to ensure the project's feasibility.

words.chinese: 明確地；特意地；特別地（表示某事是為了特定目的而做的）
words.engDef: clearly and for one particular purpose
words.example: The contract states that all changes must be approved expressly by the CEO.

words.chinese: 延長的；擴展的；延伸的
words.engDef: made longer in time or distance
words.example: The project deadline has been extended due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 延伸；擴展；擴大
words.engDef: makes something longer, or reaches over a distance
words.example: The company plans to extend its operations into new markets next year.

words.chinese: 廣泛地；徹底地；詳盡地（指範圍廣、程度深，通常用於描述研究、調查、使用等），尤其指在廣泛的範圍內進行。
words.engDef: over a wide area or in great detail
words.example: The company conducted an extensive market research before launching the new product.

words.chinese: 從外部的；外在的；由外部提供的
words.engDef: on or from the outside of an organisation
words.example: The company outsourced its IT support externally to reduce costs.

words.chinese: 從中提取（資料、資訊等）；萃取
words.engDef: to take something out, especially information or a substance
words.example: The analyst needs to extract key data from the sales report to identify trends.

words.chinese: 捏造；偽造（通常指文件、數據或故事）；製造（產品或零件）
words.engDef: to invent false information, or to make a product
words.example: The company was accused of fabricating sales figures to attract investors.

words.chinese: 面臨；直面；遭遇
words.engDef: had to deal with a difficult situation
words.example: The company faced significant challenges due to the economic downturn.

words.chinese: 面臨；正對；處理（問題或挑戰）
words.engDef: having to deal with something, or turned towards something
words.example: The company is facing increased competition in the global market.

words.chinese: 傳真（常簡寫為 fax）
words.engDef: an exact copy, especially of written or printed material
words.example: Please send a facsimile of the signed agreement to our headquarters.

words.chinese: 事實；根據資料或證據證實的資訊
words.engDef: pieces of information known to be true
words.example: The report presented several key facts about the company's financial performance.

words.chinese: 客觀地；根據事實地；真實地
words.engDef: in a way that is based on real information
words.example: The report needs to be revised to present the data factually.

words.chinese: 未通過；失敗（指考試、測試、計畫等）
words.engDef: did not succeed or did not pass
words.example: Despite extensive training, several candidates failed the certification exam.

words.chinese: 未及格的；失敗的；未能達到標準的
words.engDef: not succeeding, or not reaching the required standard
words.example: The project is failing to meet the deadline due to unforeseen delays.

words.chinese: 忠實地；如實地；依照規定地
words.engDef: in a way that is loyal and exactly as promised
words.example: The secretary faithfully recorded all the minutes of the meeting.

words.chinese: 跟不上進度；落後於他人
words.engDef: to fail to keep up with a schedule or with others
words.example: If you fall behind on your project deadlines, inform your supervisor immediately.

words.chinese: 使熟悉；讓...對...產生認識
words.engDef: to make someone know something well
words.example: Before starting the project, it's crucial to familiarize yourself with the company's policies.

words.chinese: 使自己熟悉（某事物），了解（某事物）
words.engDef: to learn about something until you know it well
words.example: Before starting the project, it's crucial to familiarize yourself with the company's policies.

words.chinese: 遠離；與...相差甚遠；不接近
words.engDef: a long way from, or not at all like
words.example: The project's current status is far from satisfactory, requiring immediate action.

words.chinese: 偏愛的；受到青睞的；優先考慮的
words.engDef: preferred or chosen over others
words.example: The company's favored supplier offers competitive pricing and reliable delivery.

words.chinese: 特點、特色；功能、特性
words.engDef: the important or attractive parts of something
words.example: The new software boasts several key features designed to improve productivity.

words.chinese: 二月，農曆二月（通常指公曆二月）
words.engDef: the second month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for February next year.

words.chinese: 虛構的；想像的；不真實的
words.engDef: invented and not real
words.example: The company's annual report included a fictitious sales figure to inflate its perceived value.

words.chinese: 田野；領域；專業領域
words.engDef: areas of study or work, or open land
words.example: The company is expanding its operations into new fields of technology.

words.chinese: 十五；15
words.engDef: the number 15
words.example: The project deadline is in fifteen days.

words.chinese: 第五；第五個（序數詞）
words.engDef: coming after the fourth
words.example: The fifth floor houses the marketing department.

words.chinese: 弄清楚；找出解決方案；理解
words.engDef: to understand something after thinking about it
words.example: After reviewing the data, we need to figure out how to reduce operational costs.

words.chinese: 文件夾；檔案夾，用於整理和存放文件。
words.engDef: a cover for holding loose papers together
words.example: Please file these documents in the appropriate file folder.

words.chinese: 歸檔；提交（文件、申請等）
words.engDef: put a document into a proper place, or officially submitted it
words.example: The HR department requires all employees to file their expense reports by the end of the month.

words.chinese: 檔案（數位或紙本），文件
words.engDef: documents kept together, or sets of data on a computer
words.example: Please upload the sales files to the shared drive.

words.chinese: 歸檔；整理文件
words.engDef: putting documents in order so they can be found
words.example: Please file these documents alphabetically in the designated cabinet.

words.chinese: 檔案櫃；文件櫃
words.engDef: a piece of furniture with drawers for storing documents
words.example: The receptionist needs to organize the incoming documents in the filing cabinet.

words.chinese: 暫代職務；頂替（某人）
words.engDef: to do someone else's job while they are away
words.example: Since Mr. Lee is on sick leave, I'll fill in for him at the meeting.

words.chinese: 填寫（表格、申請表等）；完成填寫
words.engDef: to write the required information on a form
words.example: Please fill out this form with your personal information before submitting it.

words.chinese: 填滿的；被...裝滿的；被...佔據的
words.engDef: made full
words.example: The report indicated that all the positions were filled by qualified candidates.

words.chinese: 最終定案；完成並確認
words.engDef: to complete the last details of something
words.example: The marketing team needs to finalize the presentation slides before the client meeting.

words.chinese: 最終確定；完成定案
words.engDef: completed and settled in its final form
words.example: The contract has been finalized and is ready for signatures.

words.chinese: 查明； выяснить； 發現（真相、資訊等）
words.engDef: to learn a fact you did not know
words.example: The marketing team needs to find out what the customer's expectations are for the new product.

words.chinese: 研究結果；發現（通常指經過分析後的結論）
words.engDef: the information produced by research or an investigation
words.example: The company's findings indicated a significant increase in customer satisfaction after implementing the new training program.

words.chinese: 精細地；細緻地；以細膩的方式
words.engDef: in small pieces, or with great care and precision
words.example: The documents were finely edited to ensure accuracy and clarity.

words.chinese: 完成；結束；告一段落
words.engDef: completed
words.example: The project is finished ahead of schedule and under budget.

words.chinese: 完成；結束；終止
words.engDef: brings something to an end
words.example: The project team needs to finish the report by Friday.

words.chinese: 完成；結束；終結
words.engDef: bringing something to an end
words.example: The project team is working diligently to finish the report by the deadline.

words.chinese: 公司；企業（通常指規模較小或專業性較強的公司）
words.engDef: companies, especially smaller professional ones
words.example: Several small firms are competing for the government contract.

words.chinese: 首要優先順序；最重要的任務
words.engDef: the thing that must be dealt with before anything else
words.example: Addressing the system outage is our first priority right now.

words.chinese: 首要步驟；初步行動
words.engDef: the first action taken in a process
words.example: The first step in resolving this issue is to gather all relevant data.

words.chinese: 直接的；第一手的；親身經歷的
words.engDef: from your own direct experience
words.example: The report is based on firsthand accounts from employees at the factory.

words.chinese: 首先；第一，用於引導一系列步驟或論點。
words.engDef: used to introduce the first point in a list
words.example: Firstly, please review the attached document for any discrepancies.

words.chinese: 合身；符合；適應
words.engDef: is the right size or shape for something
words.example: The new software fits our company's existing IT infrastructure seamlessly.

words.chinese: （服裝、家具等）量身訂做的；合身的
words.engDef: made or shaped to suit something exactly
words.example: The tailor provided a perfectly fitted suit for the important business meeting.

words.chinese: 有缺陷的；有缺點的；不完美的
words.engDef: having a fault that spoils it
words.example: The initial proposal had some flawed assumptions that needed to be revised.

words.chinese: 完美無瑕的；沒有缺點的
words.engDef: perfect, with no faults at all
words.example: The presentation was flawless, leaving a lasting positive impression on the board of directors.

words.chinese: 彈性工時制
words.engDef: a system of working with starting/finishing times chosen by the employee
words.example: The introduction of flextime led to a noticeable boost in employee morale.

words.chinese: 樓層（指建築物內的一層）
words.engDef: the levels of a building, or the surfaces you walk on
words.example: The meeting will be held on the tenth floor of the office building.

words.chinese: 掙扎應付；手忙腳亂地應對（某事）
words.engDef: struggled and made mistakes in a difficult situation
words.example: The new employee floundered during his first presentation, lacking confidence and preparation.

words.chinese: 專注於；致力於；將注意力集中於
words.engDef: to give all your attention to one thing
words.example: The marketing team needs to focus on increasing brand awareness in the Asian market.

words.chinese: 摺疊；將某物彎曲或將其折疊起來。
words.engDef: to bend something so one part lies over another
words.example: Please fold the brochures neatly before placing them in the display boxes.

words.chinese: 摺疊收納；將…摺疊起來
words.engDef: to bend something into a smaller shape for storing
words.example: Please fold up the presentation materials after the meeting.

words.chinese: 文件夾；資料夾，用於整理和儲存文件。
words.engDef: a cover or case for keeping papers or computer files in
words.example: Please save the presentation files in the 'Marketing' folder.

words.chinese: 文件資料夾；用於整理和儲存文件的容器
words.engDef: covers or cases for keeping papers or computer files in
words.example: Please organize all the project documents into separate folders.

words.chinese: 摺疊；將物品對摺或彎曲使其變小。
words.engDef: bending something so that one part lies over another
words.example: The office manager asked the staff to fold the documents neatly before storing them.

words.chinese: 跟隨；繼承；遵從
words.engDef: came after, or obeyed
words.example: The project manager closely followed the progress report to ensure timely completion.

words.chinese: 接著；隨後
words.engDef: with something coming immediately afterwards
words.example: The meeting will be followed by a networking reception.

words.chinese: 下週；未來一周
words.engDef: the week after the one being talked about
words.example: The project deadline has been moved to the following week.

words.chinese: 依照；遵循；繼承
words.engDef: comes after, or obeys a rule
words.example: Please follow the instructions carefully to complete the registration process.

words.chinese: 腳註；補充說明；附註
words.engDef: a note at the bottom of a page giving extra information
words.example: Please refer to the footnote at the bottom of the page for more information.

words.chinese: 腳凳；讓腳部得以放鬆的矮凳，通常放置在辦公椅或沙發前方。
words.engDef: a low support on which to rest your feet
words.example: The ergonomic chair comes with an adjustable footrest to improve comfort during long work hours.

words.chinese: 暫時；短暫時間
words.engDef: briefly; not for long
words.example: The project manager needs to stay late for a short time to finalize the report.

words.chinese: 已久；長久以來
words.engDef: for a very long time
words.example: We've been using this software for ages, and it's proven to be reliable.

words.chinese: 為商業目的；為了商業活動
words.engDef: for work purposes rather than pleasure
words.example: We need to create a marketing campaign for business.

words.chinese: 目前；就目前而言
words.engDef: until the situation changes
words.example: We're accepting applications for the position, for now, until the end of the month.

words.chinese: 首要的；最重要的；在最前面
words.engDef: most important or best known
words.example: Our foremost priority is to ensure customer satisfaction.

words.chinese: 健忘地；粗心大意地
words.engDef: in a way that shows you have forgotten things
words.example: He often makes mistakes because he works forgetfully, not paying attention to details.

words.chinese: 忘記；遺漏
words.engDef: failed to remember
words.example: I forgot to include the attachment in the email.

words.chinese: 正式地；依照慣例或規定
words.engDef: in an official way that follows the accepted rules
words.example: Please submit your expense report formally through the company's online portal.

words.chinese: 先前；過去（指某事物曾經是，但現在不再是）
words.engDef: in the past, but not now
words.example: The company was formerly known as GlobalTech Solutions.

words.chinese: 正在形成、塑造或建立的過程。
words.engDef: starting to exist or taking shape
words.example: The company is currently forming a new department to handle international sales.

words.chinese: 表格；申請表格；文件
words.engDef: printed documents with spaces for you to write information
words.example: Please fill out the necessary forms before your appointment.

words.chinese: 兩週；一個週期為 14 天的時間。
words.engDef: a period of two weeks
words.example: The project deadline has been extended by a fortnight.

words.chinese: 幸運地；值得慶幸地
words.engDef: luckily; it is good that this happened
words.example: Fortunately, the shipment arrived on time despite the unexpected delays.

words.chinese: 四十
words.engDef: the number 40
words.example: The project is expected to take approximately forty days to complete.

words.chinese: 轉寄地址；郵件或信件的轉寄地址，通常用於員工離職或公司搬遷時使用。
words.engDef: the new address to which post should be sent on
words.example: Please let us know your forwarding address so we can send you important documents.

words.chinese: 第四；四分之一
words.engDef: coming after the third
words.example: The project is currently in its fourth phase of development.

words.chinese: 裝框的；以…為框架的；（問題、議題等）被框定的
words.engDef: put in a frame, or presented in a particular way
words.example: The company decided to frame the employee's achievements on a wall to recognize their hard work.

words.chinese: 頻繁地；經常地（指時間上或程度上的高頻率）
words.engDef: often
words.example: The manager requests that all reports be submitted frequently to monitor project progress.

words.chinese: 星期五，工作週的第五天，通常是週末前夕。
words.engDef: the day after Thursday
words.example: The deadline for the project proposal is Friday.

words.chinese: 星期五，指一周中的第五天，常與週末休假相關。
words.engDef: the days of the week that come after Thursday
words.example: Our team usually has a project review meeting every Friday afternoon.

words.chinese: 從現在開始；從此刻起
words.engDef: starting at this moment
words.example: The new policy will be effective from now on.

words.chinese: 從今天開始，之後便...
words.engDef: starting today and continuing after that
words.example: From this day onward, all project deadlines will be strictly enforced.

words.chinese: 因未能達成目標或期望而感到沮喪、惱火。
words.engDef: annoyed because you cannot do what you want
words.example: The project manager was frustrated by the constant delays and lack of communication.

words.chinese: 令人沮喪的；使人感到受挫的，通常指由於困難或延遲而產生的負面情緒。
words.engDef: making you annoyed because progress is blocked
words.example: The constant technical glitches during the presentation were incredibly frustrating for both the speaker and the audience.

words.chinese: 藤原 (姓氏)，指日本歷史上具有影響力的藤原氏家族，通常用於提及日本傳統文化或歷史背景。
words.engDef: a Japanese family name
words.example: The presentation included a brief history of the Fujiwara clan and their impact on Japanese politics.

words.chinese: 實現；滿足（需求、承諾等）；履行
words.engDef: to do what is promised, needed, or required
words.example: Our company is committed to fulfilling all customer orders within the promised timeframe.

words.chinese: 完全地；徹底地
words.engDef: completely
words.example: The report needs to be reviewed fully before it's submitted to the board.

words.chinese: 職能；功能；作用
words.engDef: the purposes or duties that something has
words.example: Each department has specific functions within the company.

words.chinese: 家具及裝飾品（指為辦公室或住宅等空間配置的移動性物品）
words.engDef: the furniture and fittings that make a room usable
words.example: The company is investing in new furnishings to improve the office environment.

words.chinese: 僅供參考；供知悉
words.engDef: sent so that you know about it, with no action needed
words.example: FYI, the meeting has been rescheduled to next Tuesday.

words.chinese: 獲得；取得；增加
words.engDef: obtained or increased something
words.example: The company gained a significant market share after launching the new product.

words.chinese: 收集、整理（物品或資訊），聚集
words.engDef: to collect things together from different places
words.example: Please gather up all the documents related to the project before the meeting.

words.chinese: 聚集；收集；匯集
words.engDef: brought or came together in one place
words.example: The team gathered in the conference room to discuss the project's progress.

words.chinese: 聚集空間；用於員工或參與者交流、討論或活動的區域。
words.engDef: an area where people can meet and talk together
words.example: The company is redesigning the office to include more gathering spaces for team collaboration.

words.chinese: 通常；一般而言
words.engDef: usually; in most cases
words.example: Generally, the project is on schedule and within budget.

words.chinese: 通用的；非特定品牌的；標準化的
words.engDef: general rather than belonging to one particular brand
