words.example: After a long meeting, he leaned back in his chair and sighed.

words.chinese: 將...交由...決定；讓...自行處理
words.engDef: to let someone else decide or handle something
words.example: The manager decided to leave the scheduling up to her assistant.

words.chinese: 將…留下給…；使…處於…狀態
words.engDef: to put something in someone's care
words.example: The manager left the project with the senior team member to ensure its successful completion.

words.chinese: 演講、講座（通常為正式且結構化的內容）
words.engDef: formal talks given to teach a group of people
words.example: The CEO will deliver a lecture on the company's future strategy at the annual conference.

words.chinese: 易於辨讀的；字跡清晰的
words.engDef: clear enough to be read
words.example: The contract needs to be printed in a legible font so that all parties can easily review it.

words.chinese: 信頭；帶有公司名稱、地址、標誌等資訊的信紙。
words.engDef: printed paper with a company's name and address at the top
words.example: Please print the official letter on company letterhead.

words.chinese: 信件；書信（通常指正式或商業性質的書面溝通）
words.engDef: written messages sent by post
words.example: The accounting department needs to review all incoming letters for potential invoices.

words.chinese: 聯絡，聯絡人
words.engDef: communication or cooperation which facilitates a close working relationship
words.example: She acts as a liaison between the marketing department and the design team.

words.chinese: 良；好的；優良的；適當的
words.engDef: a family name; also a traditional Chinese unit of weight
words.example: The quality of this product is excellent; it's a good buy.

words.chinese: 打火機；（較輕的）重量
words.engDef: a small device for lighting cigarettes; less heavy
words.example: Could you please lend me a lighter to light the candles?

words.chinese: 輕微地；不重地；以輕柔的方式
words.engDef: gently and with little force
words.example: Please handle the fragile documents lightly to avoid damage.

words.chinese: 有限的；受限制的；數量或範圍有限
words.engDef: small in amount or restricted in some way
words.example: Due to budget constraints, our marketing campaign will have a limited scope this quarter.

words.chinese: 極限；限制；界限
words.engDef: the points beyond which something cannot go
words.example: The project budget has a strict limit of $10,000.

words.chinese: 林肯 (人名); 指美國前總統亞伯拉罕·林肯。
words.engDef: a family name, also a city and a former US president
words.example: The company's founder often referenced Lincoln's leadership style in his speeches.

words.chinese: 排隊；整齊排列
words.engDef: to form a queue, or to arrange things in a straight row
words.example: Please line up at the reception desk to collect your name badges.

words.chinese: 線性的；循序漸進的；按直線排列的
words.engDef: arranged in a straight line or in a fixed order
words.example: The project timeline was designed to be linear, with clear milestones for each phase.

words.chinese: 線條；排隊的人或物；（電話）線路
words.engDef: long thin marks, or queues of people
words.example: Please ensure all documents are aligned on the lines for easy readability.

words.chinese: 被列入清單的；被記載的；被包含在名單中的
words.engDef: written down as part of a list
words.example: The company's products are listed on several major online marketplaces.

words.chinese: 居住；生活（在某地）
words.engDef: had your home in a place
words.example: The company's CEO lived in New York for many years before relocating to London.

words.chinese: 生活；生存；居住
words.engDef: the periods during which people are alive; has a home somewhere
words.example: The company offers a generous relocation package to help employees adjust to their new lives.

words.chinese: 在當地；在本地；局部的
words.engDef: in the area near where you are
words.example: The company prefers to hire locally to support the community.

words.chinese: 地點；位置（通常指多個地點或特定區域）
words.engDef: the particular places where something is
words.example: Our company has several locations throughout the city, allowing us to serve a wider customer base.

words.chinese: 將自己鎖在門外；不小心將鑰匙留在外面，無法進入。
words.engDef: to shut yourself out by leaving the key inside
words.example: I locked myself out of the office this morning and had to call security to let me in.

words.chinese: 尋找；搜尋（某物或某人）
words.engDef: to try to find something
words.example: The HR department is looking for a qualified candidate to fill the vacant position.

words.chinese: 期待（某事發生），盼望
words.engDef: to feel pleased about something that will happen
words.example: We look forward to hearing from you soon regarding the project proposal.

words.chinese: 調查；審查；仔細研究（某事）
words.engDef: to examine a matter in order to find out the facts
words.example: The manager will look into the matter and provide a solution by the end of the week.

words.chinese: 審閱；仔細檢查（文件、報告等），通常是為了找出錯誤或提出建議。
words.engDef: to examine something quickly to check it
words.example: Before submitting the report, please look over it carefully for any typos or inconsistencies.

words.chinese: 查詢（資料、資訊）；查閱（字典、詞典）；尋找（解決方案）
words.engDef: to search for information in a book or system
words.example: Before finalizing the contract, please look up the legal precedents to ensure compliance.

words.chinese: 鬆散地；不嚴謹地；隨意地
words.engDef: not tightly, or not exactly
words.example: The document was filed loosely in the cabinet, making it difficult to locate.

words.chinese: 大量的；許多（用於非正式場合，強調數量多，但不如 'a lot of' 正式）
words.engDef: a large number or amount
words.example: We received lots of positive feedback on the new marketing campaign.

words.chinese: 有限公司（Limited），表示公司為股份有限公司，股東對公司債務的責任有限於其所持股額。
words.engDef: short for limited, used after a company's name
words.example: ABC Ltd. is a leading supplier of industrial equipment.

words.chinese: 午餐時間；午休時間（通常指工作或學習期間的休息時間，專用於用餐）
words.engDef: the part of the day when people eat lunch
words.example: Let's schedule a meeting after lunchtime.

words.chinese: 郵箱；信箱（用於接收郵件的容器）
words.engDef: a box where letters are delivered or posted
words.example: Please deposit the contract into the mailbox in the reception area.

words.chinese: 郵寄；郵件寄送
words.engDef: the act of sending letters or packages by post
words.example: The marketing department is preparing a mass mailing to promote the new product.

words.chinese: 郵件（複數）；郵件內容
words.engDef: letters and packages sent by post
words.example: The marketing team needs to send out promotional mails to potential clients.

words.chinese: 主要地；大體上；主要地
words.engDef: for the most part
words.example: The company mainly focuses on developing sustainable energy solutions.

words.chinese: 使...成為例行習慣
words.engDef: to start doing something regularly
words.example: To improve employee wellness, the company encourages employees to make regular exercise a habit.

words.chinese: 根據現有資訊做出判斷或結論；歸納出結論
words.engDef: to decide something after considering the facts
words.example: After analyzing the sales data, the marketing team was able to make a conclusion that the new campaign was successful.

words.chinese: 複製一份；製作副本
words.engDef: to produce a duplicate of a document
words.example: Could you please make a copy of this report for the team?

words.chinese: 指出並修正錯誤；修改
words.engDef: to change something so that it is right
words.example: Could you make a correction to the report before submitting it to the manager?

words.chinese: 做出決定；決定
words.engDef: to choose what to do
words.example: After careful consideration, the management team needs to make a decision regarding the new marketing strategy.

words.chinese: 進行最後修改；完成最終調整
words.engDef: to make the last alteration before finishing
words.example: After reviewing the draft, please make a final change before submitting it to the manager.

words.chinese: 犯錯；出錯；做出錯誤判斷
words.engDef: to do something wrongly
words.example: I made a mistake in the report, so I need to correct it before submitting.

words.chinese: 記錄下來；注意並記下
words.engDef: to write something down so you remember it
words.example: Please make a note of the deadline for the project proposal.

words.chinese: 特別注意、特別重視（做某事），刻意做到（某事）
words.engDef: to take particular care to do something
words.example: Our company makes a point of providing excellent customer service to retain clients.

words.chinese: 修改；修正（文件、計畫等），以使其更準確或更完善。
words.engDef: to change a document to improve or correct it
words.example: The marketing team needs to make a revision to the presentation slides before the client meeting.

words.chinese: 從選項中挑選；做出選擇
words.engDef: to choose from a set of options
words.example: After reviewing all the candidates, the hiring manager will make a selection.

words.chinese: 預約（時間）；安排（會議、諮詢等）
words.engDef: to arrange a time to meet someone
words.example: I need to make an appointment with the doctor to discuss my health concerns.

words.chinese: 安排；協調（行程、會議、約會等），通常涉及提前規劃和確認。
words.engDef: to plan the details of something in advance
words.example: Could you please make an arrangement for a meeting with the marketing team next week?

words.chinese: 犯錯；出錯（指在工作或任務中出現錯誤）
words.engDef: to do something wrongly
words.example: The auditor discovered several errors in the financial report.

words.chinese: 沒有影響；不造成差異
words.engDef: to have no effect on the situation
words.example: The change in supplier will make no difference to the quality of our products.

words.chinese: 為...騰出空間；讓...有足夠的空間
words.engDef: to create space for something or someone
words.example: We need to make room for the new marketing campaign in the budget.

words.chinese: 確保；務必，確定
words.engDef: to check that something is true or done
words.example: Please make sure all documents are signed before submitting them to the legal department.

words.chinese: 彌補；補償；抵消
words.engDef: to do something good that balances an earlier fault
words.example: The company offered a discount to make up for the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 做出決定；下定決心
words.engDef: to decide finally what to do
words.example: After reviewing the proposals, the committee needs to make up its mind about which vendor to choose.

words.chinese: 製造；促成；使…成為
words.engDef: produces or causes something
words.example: This new software makes data analysis much faster and more efficient.

words.chinese: 標記；註記；顯著的；重要的
words.engDef: having a mark on it, or clear and noticeable
words.example: The report was marked as 'Urgent' to ensure immediate attention.

words.chinese: 明顯地；顯著地；可察覺地（表示程度或變化非常大）
words.engDef: in a way that is very easy to notice
words.example: The company's profits increased markedly after the implementation of the new marketing strategy.

words.chinese: 分數；記號；標記（用於評估或識別）
words.engDef: signs or spots on a surface; scores given for work
words.example: The manager will review the employee's performance marks to determine salary adjustments.

words.chinese: 馬文 (Marvin) 是常見的男性名字，在商務情境中通常指稱某位員工或客戶。
words.engDef: a male first name
words.example: Marvin from the sales department will be handling the Johnson account.

words.chinese: 火柴；（與某事物）相符，一致
words.engDef: things that are the same or suit each other; small fire sticks
words.example: The presentation slides don't match the data in the report.

words.chinese: 重要的事情；問題；事務
words.engDef: subjects or situations that must be dealt with
words.example: Let's address the urgent matters first and then move on to the less critical ones.

words.chinese: 莫里奇歐（Maurizio）是一個意大利男子名，在商務情境中通常指稱某位名叫莫里奇歐的商業人士或員工。
words.engDef: an Italian male first name
words.example: Could you please forward this document to Maurizio in the sales department?

words.chinese: 最大值；最高限度
words.engDef: the largest amount possible
words.example: The system can handle a maximum of 100 users simultaneously.

words.chinese: 麥克林 (地名)：位於美國維吉尼亞州北部的一個城市或地區，通常指位於華盛頓特區附近的麥克林郡。
words.engDef: a place name in the United States
words.example: Our company is relocating its headquarters to McLean, Virginia, to be closer to key clients.

words.chinese: 員工餐券，允許員工在公司指定餐廳或合作餐廳享用餐點的憑證。
words.engDef: a voucher that lets an employee get a meal
words.example: The company offers employees a generous meal pass benefit to encourage healthy eating.

words.chinese: 有意義的；重要的；富含內涵的
words.engDef: having a clear purpose or real importance
words.example: The manager emphasized the importance of creating meaningful projects for the team.

words.chinese: 意圖；打算；表示
words.engDef: intended something, or had a particular meaning
words.example: The company's policy meant that overtime work was mandatory during the peak season.

words.chinese: 在...期間；同時，此時
words.engDef: the period of time until something else happens
words.example: We're working on the report; in the meantime, please review the preliminary data.

words.chinese: 同時；在...期間（表示兩個或多個事件同時發生或在某段時間內進行）
words.engDef: during the same period of time
words.example: The marketing team is developing a new campaign, meanwhile, the sales department is focusing on existing clients.

words.chinese: 在截止日期前完成任務或提交成果
words.engDef: to finish work by the time it is due
words.example: We need to meet the deadline for this project to avoid penalties.

words.chinese: 符合規定或標準；達到要求
words.engDef: to satisfy the conditions that are asked for
words.example: To secure the contract, our proposal must meet the client's requirements.

words.chinese: 符合標準；達到要求的
words.engDef: to be as good as the level demanded
words.example: Our new product must meet the industry's safety standards before it can be launched.

words.chinese: 備忘錄；簡短的通知或訊息
words.engDef: a short written message inside an organisation
words.example: Please read the memo regarding the upcoming company picnic.

words.chinese: 回憶錄；自傳體回憶錄（通常由知名人士撰寫，記錄個人經歷與觀點）
words.engDef: a book in which someone writes about their own life
words.example: The CEO's memoirs offer valuable insights into the company's strategic decisions over the past decade.

words.chinese: 備忘錄（常簡寫為 memo）
words.engDef: a written message in business or diplomacy
words.example: The CEO issued a memorandum regarding the new remote work policy.

words.chinese: 男性；男子
words.engDef: adult male people
words.example: The meeting room is reserved for men only.

words.chinese: 搞砸；出錯；弄亂（計畫、工作等）
words.engDef: to spoil something or do it badly
words.example: We can't mess up this deal; it's crucial for the company's future.

words.chinese: 搞亂；弄糟；使混亂（通常指非故意的結果）
words.engDef: made something untidy or spoiled it
words.example: I accidentally messed up the report with incorrect data.

words.chinese: 中期；中段；中間的
words.engDef: in the middle of a period or place
words.example: The company is currently in the mid-stage of its expansion plan.

words.chinese: 中午；正午
words.engDef: twelve o'clock in the day
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for midday to accommodate everyone's availability.

words.chinese: 市中心區域，通常指商業活動和辦公樓集中的區域。
words.engDef: the central business part of a city
words.example: Our new office is conveniently located in midtown, close to public transportation.

words.chinese: （罕見用法，指某種微小的、不重要的東西或問題，通常帶有輕蔑或不屑的意味）
words.engDef: a family name used as an example of an ordinary person
words.example: Let's not get bogged down in these minor miggins; focus on the bigger picture.

words.chinese: 米爾德雷德（Mildred）是一個女性名字，在商務情境中通常指稱某位女性員工或客戶。
words.engDef: a female first name
words.example: Mildred from the accounting department will be handling the invoice processing.

words.chinese: 毫；千分之一（英制單位，常用於衡量厚度或尺寸）
words.engDef: a female first name
words.example: The fabric is incredibly thin, measuring only 0.5 millies.

words.chinese: 分鐘；極小的一段時間
words.engDef: short for minute or minimum
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for 30 mins.

words.chinese: 專注於當下，有意識地覺察自身思緒、感受和行為，以提升工作效率和減少壓力。
words.engDef: keeping something in mind and paying careful attention
words.example: To improve productivity, employees are encouraged to practice mindful working techniques.

words.chinese: 思緒；想法；心智；觀點
words.engDef: people's thoughts and ability to think
words.example: The manager needs to consider all points of view before making a decision.

words.chinese: 小型；微型；小尺寸的
words.engDef: very small of its kind
words.example: The company is launching a mini version of its popular laptop to appeal to students.

words.chinese: 在最低限度上；盡可能少地
words.engDef: to the smallest degree possible
words.example: The company is trying to minimize costs, operating minimally to stay within budget.

words.chinese: 最小；最少的（數量、程度等）
words.engDef: smallest in amount
words.example: The company is looking for ways to minimize operating costs.

words.chinese: 分鐘（時間單位，通常用於商務情境中表示時間長度）
words.engDef: minutes
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for 30 mins.

words.chinese: 減去；負的；缺點
words.engDef: less the amount of; below zero
words.example: Ten minus three equals seven.

words.chinese: 會議記錄
words.engDef: the official written record of the meetings and discussions
words.example: The secretary took detailed minutes during the board meeting.

words.chinese: 錯誤地；錯誤地理解或處理
words.engDef: a beginning meaning wrongly or badly
words.example: I misread the contract and signed it without realizing the unfavorable terms.

words.chinese: 各種零星的、不屬於同一類別的事物或項目。
words.engDef: made up of various different things
words.example: Please submit a list of miscellaneous expenses for reimbursement.

words.chinese: 將某物放置於不該放置的地方，或暫時找不到某物。
words.engDef: to put something where you cannot find it again
words.example: I seem to have misplaced my presentation notes; could someone help me find them?

words.chinese: 印刷錯誤；誤印
words.engDef: a mistake in printed text
words.example: We need to reprint the brochures as there are several misprints on the first batch.

words.chinese: 錯過；遺漏；未達到
words.engDef: failed to catch, attend, or notice something
words.example: I missed the deadline for submitting the project proposal.

words.chinese: 遺漏；未達到（目標、期望等）
words.engDef: fails to hit, reach, or attend something
words.example: The project team misses the deadline due to unexpected delays.

words.chinese: 錯誤地；錯誤地認為或做某事
words.engDef: because of a wrong belief; by mistake
words.example: The report was submitted with some figures mistakenly entered.

words.chinese: 錯誤；失誤；過失（通常指在工作或學習中發生的），需要被修正或避免。
words.engDef: things done wrongly
words.example: Let's review the report carefully to avoid any mistakes before submitting it to the board.

words.chinese: 混合的；混雜的；包含多種元素的
words.engDef: made up of different kinds together
words.example: The company's portfolio is a mixed bag of investments, ranging from tech startups to established corporations.

words.chinese: 修飾詞；限定詞，用來改變或限定其他詞語的意義。
words.engDef: a word that describes or limits another word
words.example: The company's marketing strategy needs a significant modifier to better target the younger demographic.

words.chinese: 暫時地；片刻間
words.engDef: for a very short time; in a moment
words.example: Please wait momentarily while I retrieve the document.

words.chinese: 短暫的；一時的；瞬間的
words.engDef: lasting for a very short time
words.example: The system experienced a momentary outage, but it's back online now.

words.chinese: 星期一；週一
words.engDef: the day after Sunday
words.example: The deadline for the project proposal is next Monday.

words.chinese: 此外；而且；更進一步地
words.engDef: in addition to what has been said
words.example: The project was completed ahead of schedule; moreover, it was under budget.

words.chinese: 移動；轉移；搬遷
words.engDef: to go from one place to another
words.example: The company is planning to move its headquarters to a larger office space.

words.chinese: 在特定區域內移動或瀏覽，通常指非固定位置的活動。
words.engDef: to change position or go from place to place
words.example: During the conference, attendees are encouraged to move around and network with other professionals.

words.chinese: 向前推進；繼續進行；（計畫、討論等）繼續發展
words.engDef: to make progress with a plan
words.example: The project is moving forward smoothly despite some initial challenges.

words.chinese: 移動；變動；行動
words.engDef: changes of position, or actions taken to achieve something
words.example: The company is making strategic moves to expand its market share.

words.chinese: （尤指德國）穆勒，常見於姓氏，在商務情境中可能指代某位名叫穆勒的員工或合作夥伴。
words.engDef: a German family name
words.example: Mr. Mueller from the sales department will be leading the presentation.

words.chinese: 同時處理多項任務，或在短時間內快速切換處理不同任務。
words.engDef: to do several jobs at the same time
words.example: She's a highly efficient employee who can multitask effectively under pressure.

words.chinese: 平淡乏味的；日常的；缺乏新意的
words.engDef: ordinary and not interesting
words.example: The daily routine can be quite mundane, but it's essential for maintaining efficiency.

words.chinese: 互相的；共同的
words.engDef: in a way that both sides share equally
words.example: The company and its employees have a mutually beneficial relationship.

words.chinese: 姓名牌；身分證（通常用於識別員工或會議參與者）
words.engDef: a badge showing a person's name
words.example: Please remember to wear your name tag during the conference.

words.chinese: 被...命名；名為
words.engDef: given a name, or mentioned by name
words.example: The new product is named 'Nova' to reflect its innovative features.

words.chinese: 指定的代表；被授權代表
words.engDef: the person officially appointed to act for others
words.example: Please direct all inquiries regarding this contract to the named representative, Mr. Johnson.

words.chinese: 更窄的；比...更狹窄的
words.engDef: less wide than something else
words.example: The new office layout allows for narrower aisles to maximize space.

words.chinese: 險些；幾乎，形容某事差點發生或達到某種狀態，通常帶有驚險或接近失敗的意味。
words.engDef: by only a small amount
words.example: The company narrowly avoided a major financial crisis thanks to the quick intervention of the board.

words.chinese: 整潔地；有條理地

words.chinese: 新的預約安排；新的約會。

words.chinese: 新近的；剛開始的；最近才有的

words.chinese: 報紙；新聞報導（通常指定期發行的印刷品）

words.example: The company distributes newspapers to all employees every morning to keep them updated on industry news.

words.chinese: 報刊攤；雜誌販售點

words.example: I stopped by the newsstand to pick up a copy of the latest business journal.

words.chinese: 緊鄰；在...旁邊

words.chinese: 夜班；夜間工作時段
words.engDef: the period of work during the night
words.example: Due to increased demand, we're offering overtime pay for employees working the night shift.

words.chinese: 夜晚；夜間（多指連續的夜晚）
words.engDef: the periods of darkness between evening and morning
words.example: Due to the power outage, we had to work late into the nights to meet the deadline.

words.chinese: 靈巧的；敏捷的，指動作或反應迅速。

words.chinese: 不；沒有；否定的

words.chinese: 標準營業時間
words.engDef: the usual times when a business is open
words.example: Our normal operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

words.chinese: 使標準化；使符合常態；調整到正常水平

words.example: The company is working to normalize its operations after the recent supply chain disruption.

words.chinese: 通常地；一般而言

words.example: The meeting is normally held on the first Tuesday of each month.

words.english: not only A but also B

words.example: The company not only provides excellent customer service but also offers competitive pricing.

words.chinese: 尤其地；值得注意的是

words.chinese: 筆記；紀錄；備忘錄
words.engDef: short written records to help you remember
words.example: Please take notes during the meeting and distribute them to the team afterward.

words.chinese: 值得注意的；重要的；顯著的
words.engDef: interesting or important enough to deserve attention
words.example: The company's recent sales figures are noteworthy, indicating a significant market growth.

words.chinese: 公告欄；佈告欄（通常用於張貼公司內部通知、活動資訊等）
words.engDef: a board where announcements are put up
words.example: Check the noticeboard for updates on the upcoming company picnic.

words.chinese: 注意到；察覺到；發現
words.engDef: became aware of something
words.example: The manager noticed a significant drop in sales figures this quarter.

words.chinese: 公告；通知（通常指正式的、書面的公告）
words.engDef: written announcements put where people can see them
words.example: The company posted notices regarding the upcoming office renovation.

words.chinese: 通知；告知（通常指系統或應用程式發出的訊息，用以告知使用者相關資訊或事件）
words.engDef: an official message telling you that something has happened
words.example: The system will send a notification when the payment is processed.

words.chinese: 通知；告知（正式且書面），通常指透過正式管道或系統發布訊息。
words.engDef: officially told someone about something
words.example: The HR department notified employees of the upcoming policy changes via email.

words.chinese: 觀念；概念；印象
words.engDef: an idea or belief about something
words.example: The company's notion of quality is to exceed customer expectations.

words.chinese: 小說；長篇小說（通常指文學作品）
words.engDef: long written stories about imaginary people
words.example: The company library offers a wide selection of novels and business books for employees.

words.chinese: 十一月，公曆的第十一個月。
words.engDef: the eleventh month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for November 15th.

words.chinese: 令人煩擾的事物或行為；困擾
words.engDef: a person or thing that causes trouble or annoyance
words.example: The constant noise from the construction site is a real nuisance.

words.chinese: 數字；數量；編號
words.engDef: figures used for counting or identifying
words.example: Please confirm the order number before processing the shipment.

words.chinese: 細心的；善於觀察的；注意到細節的
words.engDef: quick to notice things around you
words.example: The manager is an observant leader who notices even the smallest changes in employee performance.

words.chinese: 觀察；注意到；察覺到
words.engDef: watched or noticed something carefully
words.example: The manager observed a significant drop in sales during the holiday season.

words.chinese: 過度關心或擔心某事，常因小事而困擾。
words.engDef: to think about something far too much
words.example: Don't obsess about the small details; focus on the overall project goals.

words.chinese: 偶爾地，不時地（指發生頻率不高）
words.engDef: sometimes, but not often
words.example: The company occasionally sends out promotional emails to its customers.

words.chinese: 發生；出現；恰好發生
words.engDef: happened
words.example: The system error occurred during the data transfer process.

words.chinese: 發生的；正在進行的
words.engDef: happening
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the meeting is occurring later than scheduled.

words.chinese: 微乎其微的機會；勉強的機會
words.engDef: a slight possibility that something might happen
words.example: There's an off chance that the project might be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 禁止進入或使用；不在允許範圍內
words.engDef: not allowed to be entered or used
words.example: The executive suite is off-limits to all employees except for authorized personnel.

words.chinese: 辦公室用品，指辦公室日常使用之文具、耗材及其他輔助工具。
words.engDef: the everyday materials used in an office, such as pens and paper
words.example: The company needs to order more office supplies, including paper, pens, and staplers.

words.chinese: 辦公室；公司總部
words.engDef: rooms or buildings where people do business work
words.example: The company is expanding and plans to open new offices in several major cities.

words.chinese: 正式安排；經正式確認的協議或計畫
words.engDef: a plan that has been formally agreed
words.example: The company has an official arrangement with the supplier to ensure timely delivery of raw materials.

words.chinese: 正式地；依照規定地
words.engDef: in a way that is approved by an authority
words.example: The company announced the merger officially through a press release.

words.chinese: 抵消；補償；（時間、空間等）偏移
words.engDef: to balance out the effect of something else
words.example: The company implemented a carbon offset program to reduce its environmental impact.

words.example: Offshoring tech support helped the software corporation lower operational costs.

words.chinese: 遺漏；省略（指未包含或未提及的事物）

words.chinese: 遺漏、疏漏（指未包含或未提及的事項）
words.engDef: things that have been left out
words.example: The report contained several omissions that needed to be corrected before submission.

words.chinese: 因公出差
words.engDef: away from your usual workplace for work reasons
words.example: Mr. Lee is currently on a business trip to Tokyo to attend a conference.

words.chinese: 定期地；依照常態
words.engDef: repeatedly at fixed intervals
words.example: Employees are expected to submit their expense reports on a regular basis.

words.chinese: 每週、按週進行
words.engDef: once every week
words.example: The project team submits progress reports on a weekly basis.

words.chinese: 因公出差；為了商務目的
words.engDef: travelling or meeting for work purposes
words.example: Mr. Lee is traveling to Tokyo on business next week.

words.chinese: 值班的；在工作狀態的

words.example: The security guard is on duty at the front desk.

words.chinese: 緊張不安；處於高度警戒狀態

words.example: The deadline is approaching, and everyone in the team is feeling on edge.

words.chinese: 現成的；備有的；隨時可用的
words.engDef: available and ready to be used
words.example: We have plenty of samples on hand to show potential clients.

words.chinese: 偶爾；不時地
words.engDef: sometimes, but not often
words.example: The CEO occasionally visits the branch offices to check on employee morale.

words.chinese: 獨立地；靠自己的；不需他人協助

words.example: After the training, employees are expected to manage their projects on their own.

words.chinese: 故意地；蓄意地
words.engDef: deliberately, not by accident
words.example: He didn't spill the coffee; he did it on purpose to distract me.

words.chinese: 按時的；符合進度
words.engDef: happening at the planned time
words.example: The project is on schedule and we expect to finish it by the end of the month.

words.chinese: 待命狀態；準備隨時待命
words.engDef: ready to act as soon as you are needed
words.example: The technician is on standby to fix the equipment if needed.

words.chinese: 根據…的建議；依照…的推薦
words.engDef: because someone advised it
words.example: The project was approved on the recommendation of the marketing department.

words.chinese: 準時地；按時地
words.engDef: at the correct or arranged time
words.example: Please submit your expense report on time to ensure timely reimbursement.

words.chinese: 在現場的；在工作地點的
words.engDef: at the place where the work is being done
words.example: The technician will be on-site tomorrow to repair the equipment.

words.example: We need to address this issue as one team.

words.chinese: 開啟；打開

words.example: The manager opened the meeting with a brief overview of the quarterly results.

words.chinese: 機會；空缺；開放性

words.example: The company is currently advertising several openings for marketing specialists.

words.example: The conference room opens at 7:30 AM for early arrivals.

words.chinese: 選擇方案；可能性
words.engDef: the different things you may choose
words.example: The company is exploring several options for expanding into the Asian market.

words.chinese: 通常地；一般而言
words.engDef: usually; in normal circumstances
words.example: Ordinarily, the report is submitted by the end of the month.

words.chinese: 井然有序的；有條理的；組織良好的
words.engDef: arranged in a tidy and efficient way
words.example: The project manager kept all documents organized in a shared online folder.

words.chinese: 組織者；策劃者；活動規劃者

words.example: The event organizers are responsible for coordinating all logistics and ensuring a smooth conference.

words.chinese: 組織、安排；將事物按照特定方式整理。
words.engDef: planning and arranging something
words.example: The project manager is responsible for organizing the team's tasks and deadlines.

words.engDef: aimed at or focused on something particular
words.example: Our company is customer-oriented, focusing on providing excellent service.

words.example: The company's headquarters were originally located in a smaller town.

words.engDef: to make something no longer current
words.example: New software updates can quickly outdate older versions.

words.engDef: clothes such as coats worn over other clothes

words.example: The project manager outlined the key milestones for the upcoming quarter.

words.chinese: 概述；大綱；輪廓
words.engDef: descriptions of the main points; the outer shapes of things
words.example: Before starting the project, please outline the key objectives and deliverables.

words.example: The report was overdue by a week, causing delays in the project.

words.chinese: 過度的；過多的，不必要的
words.engDef: too; more than is suitable
words.example: The report was overly detailed and included unnecessary information.

words.chinese: 過大的；尺寸過於寬敞的
words.engDef: larger than the usual size
words.example: The client returned the oversized suit because it didn't fit properly.

words.chinese: 總覽；簡要概述；摘要
words.engDef: a short description of the main points
words.example: Let's start with a brief overview of the project's current status.

words.chinese: 壓倒性的；令人不堪重負的；過多的
words.engDef: so great that it is difficult to deal with
words.example: The amount of paperwork required for this project is overwhelming.

words.chinese: 由於；因為（表示原因或理由，通常帶有負面或不愉快的意味）
words.engDef: because of
words.example: The meeting was postponed owing to unforeseen circumstances.

words.chinese: 擁有；屬於
words.engDef: belonging to someone
words.example: The company owns several patents for its innovative technology.

words.chinese: 牛津大學；牛津出版社；（形容詞）牛津的，與牛津大學或出版社相關的
words.engDef: a city in England, known for its university
words.example: The company is seeking candidates with degrees from prestigious universities, such as Oxford.

words.chinese: 將物品收納、整理起來，尤其是將物品放入儲藏空間。
words.engDef: to put things into boxes or storage
words.example: Before leaving for the weekend, please pack away all sensitive documents in the filing cabinet.

words.chinese: （容器、空間等）已滿載的；（行程、活動等）行程緊湊的
words.engDef: completely full, or having a very full schedule
words.example: The conference room was packed with attendees eager to hear the keynote speaker.

words.chinese: 墊片；緩衝墊；（電腦）滑鼠墊
words.engDef: soft pieces of material used for protection or writing
words.example: The office supplies department ordered extra mouse pads for all new employees.

words.chinese: 頁面（指文件、書籍、網站等的頁面）
words.engDef: the sheets of paper in a book, or screens on a website
words.example: The report is 25 pages long and needs to be printed.

words.chinese: 費時費力地；極度謹慎地
words.engDef: with a great deal of care and effort
words.example: The team painstakingly reviewed the contract to ensure accuracy.

words.chinese: 成對的；一對一的
words.engDef: sets of two things that go together
words.example: The company is looking for pairs of employees to participate in the cross-training program.

words.chinese: 文牘、文件（通常指大量且重複性的行政或公司文件）
words.engDef: the routine written work of an office
words.example: The new employee spent the first week completing a lot of paperwork.

words.chinese: 部分地；不完全地
words.engDef: partly; not completely
words.example: The project was completed partially due to unforeseen delays.

words.chinese: 尤其地；特別地（強調某事物在眾多事物中更為突出）
words.engDef: especially; more than usual
words.example: The report highlights the company's performance, particularly in the Asian market.

words.chinese: 合作夥伴；夥伴關係，尤其指商業或專業領域的合作關係。
words.engDef: people or firms that work together in business
words.example: Our company is seeking new partners to expand into the Asian market.

words.chinese: （文件、資訊等）傳閱；散播；分享
words.engDef: to give something to each person in turn
words.example: Please pass around the draft report for review by Friday.

words.chinese: 忽略；跳過（某事物或某人），通常指未經考慮或未經處理。
words.engDef: to ignore someone or something rather than choosing it
words.example: The manager decided to pass over several candidates and promote Sarah to the position.

words.chinese: 消磨時間；度過一段時間（通常指無聊或等待時的活動）
words.engDef: to do something so that time goes by less slowly
words.example: While waiting for the meeting to start, I like to pass the time by reading industry news.

words.engDef: to refuse a chance or offer
words.example: Don't pass up this opportunity to network with industry leaders.

words.chinese: 通過；及格；順利通過（考試、審查等）
words.engDef: went by; succeeded in a test
words.example: He passed the certification exam with flying colors.

words.chinese: 通過；經過；（時間、機會等）流逝
words.engDef: goes by; succeeds in a test; permits to enter
words.example: The deadline for submitting the proposal passes next Friday.

words.chinese: 及格的；通過的；符合最低標準的
words.engDef: going by, or good enough to succeed
words.example: The candidate needs to achieve a passing score on the exam to be considered for the position.

words.chinese: 被動地；不主動地；消極地
words.engDef: without taking action or resisting
words.example: Employees should not passively accept changes; they should actively participate in the discussion.

words.chinese: 模式；規律；趨勢（指可觀察到的重複出現的行為或趨勢）
words.engDef: regular ways in which things happen or are arranged
words.example: The sales team analyzed the customer purchase patterns to identify potential marketing opportunities.

words.engDef: touched or handled something roughly
words.example: The employee pawed through the documents, searching for the missing contract.

words.chinese: （貼紙、標籤等）撕除；（油漆、塗層等）剝落
words.engDef: to pull a thin layer away from a surface
words.example: Please peel off the price tag before displaying the merchandise.

words.chinese: 鉛筆；鉛筆組

words.example: Could you please provide extra pencils for the meeting participants?

words.chinese: 每天；每日
words.engDef: for each day
words.example: The daily rental fee is $50 per day.

words.chinese: 可察覺的；明顯的；能被感知的
words.engDef: able to be noticed or felt
words.example: The slight difference in color was barely perceptible to the untrained eye.

words.chinese: 洞察力敏銳的；善於察覺細微之處的；具有良好判斷力的。
words.engDef: quick to notice and understand things
words.example: The manager is a perceptive leader who quickly identifies potential problems.

words.chinese: 完全地；完美地（表示達到最高標準或期望）
words.engDef: completely, with nothing wrong
words.example: The report was executed perfectly, exceeding all expectations.

words.chinese: 執行；展現；呈現（某項任務、技能或表演）
words.engDef: carried out a task, or gave a public show
words.example: The team performed exceptionally well during the quarterly review.

words.chinese: 執行；展現；呈現；完成（任務或職責）
words.engDef: carries out a task or duty
words.example: The marketing team performs market research to identify potential customers.

words.chinese: 週期的；定期的
words.engDef: happening again at regular intervals
words.example: The company conducts periodic performance reviews for all employees.

words.chinese: 定期發行的刊物，例如雜誌、期刊或報告，通常以特定時間間隔發行。
words.engDef: a magazine or journal published at regular intervals
words.example: The company distributes a quarterly periodical to keep employees updated on recent developments.

words.chinese: 週期性地；不時地；定期地（但間隔時間不固定）
words.engDef: from time to time at fairly regular intervals
words.example: The company updates its website periodically to reflect new product information.

words.chinese: 永久地；不變地（表示狀態或情況不會改變）
words.engDef: for all time; without changing back
words.example: The company has decided to relocate its headquarters permanently.

words.chinese: 允許；被准許
words.engDef: officially allowed
words.example: Employees are permitted to use the company's gym during their lunch break.

words.chinese: 持續不斷的；堅持不懈的
words.engDef: continuing firmly in spite of difficulty
words.example: The sales team's persistent follow-up resulted in a significant increase in sales.

words.example: The security team is watching the surveillance footage for any suspicious activity.

words.chinese: 耗盡精力；使疲憊不堪（通常指經過長時間的努力或使用）
words.engDef: to make someone very tired, or to use something until it breaks
words.example: After a long day of negotiations, the team was completely worn out.

words.chinese: 穿著；身著
words.engDef: having clothes on your body
words.example: The CEO was wearing a sharp suit during the important presentation.

words.chinese: 星期三
words.engDef: the day after Tuesday
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for Wednesday morning at 9:00 AM.

words.chinese: 週末，通常指星期六和星期日，是工作人員休息和休閒的時間。
words.engDef: Saturdays and Sundays
words.example: Our team usually has project meetings on Monday mornings to review the weekend's progress.

words.chinese: 工作日夜晚，通常指星期一至星期五的夜晚。
words.engDef: the evenings from Monday to Friday
words.example: Due to high demand, our team often works late on weeknights to meet deadlines.

words.chinese: 遠早於；提早很多
words.engDef: a long time before something happens
words.example: Please submit your expense reports well in advance of the deadline.

words.chinese: 準備充分的；預先備好的
words.engDef: fully ready for what is going to happen
words.example: The team was well-prepared for the presentation, resulting in a successful outcome.

words.chinese: 當談到...時；就...而言時
words.engDef: on the subject of; in the matter of
words.example: When it comes to project deadlines, we need to be realistic and communicate any potential delays promptly.

words.chinese: 廣泛地；普遍地；在廣大範圍內
words.engDef: over a large area or among many people
words.example: The company's products are widely distributed throughout Asia.

words.chinese: 為手錶上鍊；調整手錶時間
words.engDef: to turn the small wheel that keeps a watch going
words.example: Before the meeting, please wind your watch to ensure you arrive on time.

words.chinese: 窗戶；（電腦）視窗
words.engDef: openings in a wall with glass; areas on a computer screen
words.example: The office building has large windows to maximize natural light.

words.chinese: 擦拭掉；清除（污漬、痕跡等）
words.engDef: to remove marks or liquid by rubbing
words.example: Please wipe off the whiteboard after the meeting to prepare for the next session.

words.chinese: 關於；就...而言；鑒於
words.engDef: concerning; in relation to
words.example: With respect to your request for a price quote, we need more details about the project scope.

words.chinese: 除...以外；不包括...
words.engDef: apart from; not including
words.example: All employees are required to attend the training session, with the exception of those on approved leave.

words.chinese: 燈光未關閉的狀態；在燈光亮著的情況下
words.engDef: while the lights are still switched on
words.example: Please leave the lights on when you're leaving early, so the security guard can see.

words.chinese: 在合理範圍內；在可接受的限度內
words.engDef: as long as the request stays sensible
words.example: We can offer a discount, but only within reason, considering our profit margins.

words.chinese: 立即；毫不延遲
words.engDef: immediately
words.example: Please submit your expense report without delay to ensure timely reimbursement.

words.chinese: 未事先通知；突然地
words.engDef: with no warning given in advance
words.example: The company announced the restructuring without notice, causing disruption to many employees.

words.chinese: 不考慮、不顧及，不加區別地
words.engDef: without considering something
words.example: The company implemented the new policy without respect to seniority.

words.chinese: 詞語；語言表達；文字
words.engDef: the units of language used in speech or writing
words.example: The contract contains specific words that could have legal implications.

words.chinese: 工作環境：指員工在辦公室或工作場所中實際工作的情境，包含物理空間、工作氛圍、同事關係等。
words.engDef: the surroundings and conditions in which people work
words.example: The company is committed to providing a positive and supportive work environment for all employees.

words.chinese: 以小組方式工作；團隊合作
words.engDef: to do a task together in small teams
words.example: To maximize efficiency, we encourage employees to work in groups for brainstorming sessions.

words.chinese: 致力於；從事於；處理（某項工作或任務）
words.engDef: to spend time doing or improving something
words.example: I'm working on a new marketing campaign for the upcoming product launch.

words.chinese: 加班，額外工作（通常指超出正常工作時間）
words.engDef: to work beyond your normal hours
words.example: Due to the approaching deadline, employees are required to work overtime this week.

words.chinese: 工作日，通常指星期一至星期五的工作天。
words.engDef: a day on which people normally work
words.example: Our office will be closed for the national holiday, so there will be no workdays next week.

words.chinese: 工作量；任務負擔
words.engDef: the amount of work a person has to do
words.example: The manager needs to redistribute the workload to ensure everyone can meet the deadline.

words.chinese: 運作；執行；工作（作為動詞）；作品（作為名詞）
words.engDef: operates properly; also things that have been produced
words.example: The new software works seamlessly with our existing systems.

words.chinese: 工作表；練習題（通常用於課堂或培訓，包含練習題或活動，供學習者完成）
words.engDef: a sheet of paper with exercises or tasks on it
words.example: The training department distributed worksheets to all participants to reinforce the concepts.

words.chinese: 工作空間
words.engDef: an area allocated for one's work, as in an office
words.example: Employees are encouraged to keep their workspace clean and clutter-free.

words.chinese: 工作站，個人辦公空間
words.engDef: an individual's work area in an office, typically with a computer
words.example: Every new employee is assigned a modern workstation with dual monitors.

words.chinese: 擔憂、顧慮；令人擔憂的事物
words.engDef: feelings of anxiety; things that make you anxious
words.example: The manager needs to address the team's worries about the upcoming deadline.

words.chinese: 令人擔憂的；引起焦慮的
words.engDef: causing anxiety
words.example: The company's declining sales figures are a worrying trend.

words.chinese: 結束；收尾；包裝完畢
words.engDef: to finish something; to cover something in paper
words.example: Let's wrap up this meeting and send out the minutes by tomorrow morning.

words.chinese: 腕錶；手錶
words.engDef: a small clock worn on the wrist
words.example: He glanced at his wristwatch to check the time before the meeting started.

words.chinese: 記錄下來；寫下（重要資訊或指示）
words.engDef: to record something on paper
words.example: Please write down the meeting minutes and distribute them to all attendees.

words.chinese: 撰寫報告；整理說明
words.engDef: to write a full report from notes
words.example: The marketing team needs to write up a report summarizing the results of the recent campaign.

words.chinese: 作家；撰寫者（通常指專業或頻繁寫作的人）
words.engDef: people who write for a living
words.example: The company is seeking experienced writers to create marketing materials.

words.chinese: 書寫；撰寫（文件、信件等）
words.engDef: puts words on paper or a screen
words.example: The marketing team needs to write a compelling proposal to secure the contract.

words.chinese: 書寫墊；便條墊，通常用於辦公室或會議中快速記錄。
words.engDef: a set of blank sheets fastened together for writing on
words.example: Could you pass me a writing pad and a pen, please? I need to jot down some notes.

words.chinese: 年度末；年末
words.engDef: relating to the end of the financial or calendar year
words.example: The year-end financial report is due by December 15th.

words.chinese: （俚語）非常；極其；驚人地
words.engDef: a male first name, short for Zachary
words.example: The project was completed zack quickly, thanks to the team's dedication.
